title: Sony Bravia Camera
body_html:
Connect the Sony BRAVIA CAM to your BRAVIA XR TV and enjoy television like never before. BRAVIA CAM recognizes where you are in the room and how far you are from the TV, then adjusts sound and picture settings so they're just right. This means audio - including dialog - is clearer and more immersive with picture brightness tailored to your viewing environment.1,2

Every picture, optimized to your position in the room
Detecting the distance between you and your TV, BRAVIA CAM adjusts TV brightness, so you’ll always enjoy perfect picture quality, no matter where you are in the room. A light and colour sensor in the TV optimizes pictures to light conditions for the best possible viewing experience.1,2

The ideal sound experience from anywhere
BRAVIA CAM follows you and your position, even if you are watching from the sides, then adjusts left and right sound balance for optimum acoustics. Wherever you are in the room, you'll enjoy the same sound quality as if you're sitting right in front of the TV.1,2

Hear voices clearly, no matter where you are
By detecting your viewing distance, BRAVIA CAM is able to adjust voice zoom automatically so you can hear dialog clearly. The volume of TV dialog increases when you move away from the TV and decreases when you get closer.1,2

Enjoy video chat with friends and family on the big screen
Catch up with your friends and family, on the big screen. Enjoy more fun by connecting your TV with BRAVIA CAM.

Easy to connect, easy to close
Attaching and detaching the supplied BRAVIA CAM to your BRAVIA TV is quick and easy. Use the camera cover switch on top of BRAVIA CAM to close the camera cover if you want more privacy at any time.

Key Features

Compatible with select 2022 Sony TVs – A95K / A90K / A80K / X95K / X90K / X85K / X80K

Enjoy video chat with friends and family on the big screen

Ambient Optimisation Pro recognises where you’re sitting in the room and automatically optimises picture and sound according to the room environment

Experience a new way to control your TV with Gesture Control. Change channels, adjust volume, and more simply by using gestures – no remote required

title: Vogel's TVM 5445 32-65" ELITE Full Motion+ TV Wall Mount (White)
body_html:
Full-motion, ultra-slim TV wall mount for high-end TVs from 32 to 65 inches
With the elegant ELITE Full-Motion+ TV wall mount, you're choosing design and performance. The wall mount is specially designed for TVs from 32 to 65 inches in size and weighing up to 35 kg, and can be turned up to 180°, allowing you to optimally enjoy your TV from any corner in the room. In the starting position, there is only 4 cm between the TV and the wall. Available in White and Platinum Grey colours.

Ultra-slim design, ultimate enjoyment
The ELITE Full-Motion+ TV wall mount is the slimmest TV wall mount in our range, yet still offers an enormous weight-bearing capacity. As such, the ELITE Full-Motion+ is the ideal TV wall mount for large high-end TVs, such as OLED and QLED TVs.

Enjoy your TV from any angle
With the ELITE Full-Motion+ TV wall mount, you can enjoy your TV from any angle. The wall mount has extra-long support arms of 56 cm. Depending on the display size, you can turn your TV up to 90° to the left and right. And thanks to OneFinger™ Movement, you can effortlessly turn your display to the desired viewing angle with just one finger. A tilt function has been omitted because it is best not to tilt large, fragile displays.

Perfection in every respect
ELITE Full-Motion+ TV wall mounts feature 2D Leveling™, which allows you to mount your TV perfectly straight, both horizontally and vertically, even after installation. And perfection also applies to the finishing touches of the wall mounts. For example, the unique Cable Inlay System (CIS®) guides the cables through the support arms, with special holders to neatly conceal the cables at the back. All technical details of the TV wall mount are nicely hidden behind stylish cover plates.

Safety first
Every ELITE Full-Motion+ TV wall mount meets the strictest safety requirements, is TUV-certified and is tested to three times its maximum weight capacity. To minimise the chance of damaging your thin, fragile display, you cannot tilt the ELITE Full-Motion+ TV wall mount.

Installation made easy
The ELITE Full-Motion+ TV wall mount is easy to install, thanks to the included Quick Install Guide with explanation. Need more help? A detailed manual is available online, plus an installation video. A spirit level, drilling template, screws and fischer® DuoPower plugs are included. Plus, the free Vogel's DrillRight™ AR app makes it easy to mark out the first drill hole. Soft patches on the wall mount protect the back of your TV during mounting.

Key Features

Smooth one finger movement

2D levelling keeps TV level at all times

Up to 180° swivel

Supports max VESA hole patterns of 400 x 400mm

Ultra slim (40mm from wall) and strong, supporting max 35kg

title: LG CineBeam HU715Q 4K UHD Laser Ultra Short Throw Projector
body_html:
Ultra Short Throw Ratio
LG Ultra Short Throw CineBeam gives vivid imagery within an exceptionally short projection distance. Create an impressive home cinema screen up to 120 inches*.
*It can project an 80-inch screen from a distance of 11.8cm, a 100-inch screen from a distance of 21.7cm, and a 120-inch screen from a distance of 31.7cm.

Vivid and Clear Picture Quality
With 8.3 mega pixels utilizing 4K UHD Laser technology, LG CineBeam delivers precisive details up to 120-inch screen. With 2M:1 contrast ratio it can express the deep darkness and brightness. And it accurately represents colours in an indoor environment, thanks to a colour gamut 85% of DCI-P3 and 2,500 ANSI Lumens brightness.

A New Level of Clarity
HDR improves quality by making the bright part brighter and the dark part darker while using the dark side details. So, it is compatible with almost HDR industry standards.

Check, Adjust, and Project Automatically
The built-in ambient sensor automatically recognizes the lighting conditions and adjusts the brightness mode suitable for the naked eye. So, you can watch the content with screen brightness optimized for ambient.
*To run 'Auto Brightness', you can turn on the ambient sensor by accessing the ‘Brightness OptimizerⅡ’ menu using the magic remote control and turning ON/OFF the 'Auto Brightness’. (During use this function, Energy saving menu is disabled). Iris mode that physically controls the contrast ratio is NOT supported.

Fits Laser Output to the Scene
Adaptive Contrast gives more depth to your image by adaptively adjusting the Laser output to image, in order to create a high contrast ratio. Bright scenes appear brighter, while dark scenes remain detailed with deep blacks and shade detail.

The Smart Way to Access Content
With webOS 6.0, you can explore a variety of TV shows and movies with a simple connect to your Wi-Fi network. Also, you can enjoy video contents with built-in apps like Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, Disney+, YouTube and Apple TV.

8.3 Mega pixels utilizing 4K UHD resolution

title: Monster 1 Socket Surge Protector (White)
body_html:
Introducing the Monster single outlet appliances surge protector - the ultimate solution for protecting your valuable appliances from power surges and voltage spikes. With a 700 joule rating and fireproof MOV technology, this surge protector is designed to effectively absorb and redirect excess voltage away from your appliances, preventing damage and prolonging their lifespan. The LED surge indicator light lets you know that your devices are protected and gives you peace of mind. But that's not all - this surge protector also comes with a remarkable $10,000 connected equipment warranty. With this warranty, you can rest assured that your appliances are covered in case of damage due to power surges. Don't risk damaging your appliances - protect them with the Monster single outlet appliances surge protector.

Why do I need a Surge Protector
A surge protector is an electrical device designed to protect your electronic devices from power surges or voltage spikes. Power surges can occur due to lightning strikes, power outages, or fluctuations in the electrical grid. Without a surge protector, these power surges can cause damage to your electronic devices, including your computer, TV, and other appliances. A surge protector helps to absorb and redirect the excess voltage away from your devices, protecting them from damage. Additionally, surge protectors can also prevent electrical fires and increase the lifespan of your electronic devices. In summary, using a surge protector can help protect your electronic devices from power surges and increase their lifespan, ultimately saving you money in the long run.

700 joule rating and fireproof MOV technology

title: Belkin Connect 6-Outlet Surge Protector with Dual USB-C 30W
body_html:
Protect the life of your electronics and appliances with 650 joules of surge protection from its 2m cable, 6 AC outlets and two fast charging USB-C PD ports. This product is rigorously tested for quality and features a Belkin 11-point safety system and best-in-class $50,000 Connected Equipment Warranty* for added peace of mind .

Key Features

650 joules of surge protection.
Reduce the risk of damage and increase the lifespan of your electronics and appliances with industry-leading protection. Our surge protector absorbs 650 joules of energy to keep your home safe from power spikes.

Power Delivery and dynamic PPS technology.
The USB-C ports offer Power Delivery charging to compatible devices, so you’ll charge faster than using standard USB-A ports. Onboard PPS (Programmable Power Supply) technology detects the connected device and negotiates the optimal amount of power needed for an ideal fast charge.

Dual USB-C ports.
Two USB-C ports provide you with convenient expansion and flexibility for when you’re missing a power brick. You’ll have up to 30W of power shared across the two ports to fast charge smartphones and many other devices.

2m power cord and built-in wall mounts.
The 2m power cord allows for easy placement under a desk or behind appliances. Plus, built-in mounting holes give you the flexibility to hang, mount, or attach your surge protector where you need it.

Protected by an 11-point safety system.
Your device is plugged into a protector that offers overvoltage, over-temperature, overload, over-current, short-circuit and clamping voltage defence. It offers 3-line AC protection (ground, neutral, and line) and is made from material that passes a Glow Wire Test at 850℃. An indicator light shows when surge protection is active, and a warning light shows when the power coming through is not grounded.

Know you’re protected at a glance.
Built-in indicator light shows you that your protection is active and working, and lets you know if it’s time to change your surge protector. A recessed power switch offers security against accidental shut off.

Stay protected with our best-in-class Connected Equipment Warranty.
Use your electronics with confidence, supported by our best-in-class warranty

*Belkin will repair or replace electronic devices damaged by an electrical charge while properly connected to this charger, up to $50,000AU. Visit belkin.com/cew for details.

Important: Be sure to regularly check the light on your surge protector. If the light is not on, the surge protector may have absorbed excess voltage from an event such as a thunderstorm or power outage. It may no longer be protecting equipment that is connected to it, and you should immediately replace it with a new surge protector. If you use the surge protector when the light is not on, your warranty will be invalidated. In any case, we recommend replacing a surge protector after three years of use, even if the light continues to come on.

title: Vogel's TVM 5645 40-77" ELITE Full Motion+ TV Wall Mount (Grey)
body_html:
Full-motion, ultra-slim TV wall mount for high-end TVs from 40 to 77 inches
The ELITE Full-Motion+ TV wall mount combines minimalistic design with great performance. The wall mount is not only ultra-slim, but also ultra-strong and can be turned up to 180°. In short, the ultimate wall mount for large high-end TVs, such as OLED and QLED TVs. The TV wall mount is suitable for displays from 40 to 77 inches in size and weighing up to 45 kg. In the starting position, your TV is mounted just 4 cm from the wall. Available in the colours White and Platinum Grey.

Watch TV comfortably from any angle
The ELITE Full-Motion+ TV wall mount has extra long support arms of 65 cm. This makes it possible to turn your TV up to 90° to the left and right, depending on your display size, enabling you to enjoy your TV optimally from any corner in the room. Turning your TV is extremely smooth, thanks to OneFinger™ Movement, you can move the display to the desired viewing angle with just one finger. Because it's best not to tilt thin, fragile displays, the tilt function has been omitted.

Refined perfection
ELITE Full-Motion+ TV wall mounts excel in perfection. The TV wall mount features 2D Leveling™, making it easy to mount your TV perfectly straight, both horizontally and vertically, even after installation. The cables run – out of sight – through the support arms thanks to the unique Cable Inlay System (CIS®). You can neatly conceal the cables at the back of your TV using the special cable holders. All technical details of the TV wall mount are nicely hidden behind elegant cover plates.

Safety guaranteed
ELITE Full-Motion+ TV wall mounts meet the most stringent safety requirements. Each TV wall mount is TüV certified and tested to three times its maximum weight capacity.

Easy to install
The ELITE Full-Motion+ TV wall mount is easy to install. It comes with a Quick Install Guide, which explains everything clearly. You'll find even more help online, including a detailed manual and the installation video. A spirit level, drilling template, screws and fischer® DuoPower plugs are included. With our free DrillRight™ AR app, you can easily mark the first drill hole. To protect the back of your TV during mounting, soft wall mount patches are included.

Key Features

Smooth one finger movement

2D levelling keeps TV level at all times

Up to 180° swivel

Ultra slim (40mm from wall) and strong, supporting max 45kg

Supports max VESA hole patterns of 600 x 400mm

Driving our Home Theatre System and soundbar with added bass, the compact SA-SW3 wireless subwoofer immerses you even deeper into movies and music. Enjoy louder, clearer bass for a more cinematic surround sound experience.

title: Samsung 55" S85F OLED 4K Smart AI TV [2025]
body_html:
Key Features

NQ4 AI Gen2 Processor
This processor uses the power of 20 AI neural networks to optimise picture and sound quality. The result is superb performance, whether you're watching streaming services, playing your favourite video games or watching live sports.1

4K AI Upscaling
Watch your favourite content in brilliant detail. Our AI processor can take content and enhance it up to 4K resolution with 20 AI neural networks all while maintaining sharp and smooth picture quality.2

OLED HDR
Samsung's processor analyses each scene and boosts for brightness. The result is a beautifully bright screen with incredible contrast, which brings hidden details to light.3

PANTONE Validated
As a trusted symbol of colour fidelity by industry experts, ‘PANTONE Validated' certifies the accurate expression of 2,140 PANTONE colours and 110 newly added skin tone shades. So you can be sure that you're getting a rich, true to life viewing experience.4

Settings that intelligently optimise picture and sound
AI Mode offers a quick access menu to adjust adaptive picture and sound settings, intelligently optimising your TV experience to the surroundings and the content you're watching.

Sound that adjusts to your surroundings & content
Experience sound just as the creators intended, with clear voices and vivid, balanced tones. Your TV's AI processor recognises different sounds and optimises them based on characteristics of both the room and audio content, before ultimately refining them with audio remastering technology.5

Samsung OLED Technology uses Self Illuminating Pixels and RGB Sub-Pixels.
Experience deep blacks, clean whites and vibrant colours with OLED. Utilising over 8 million specially engineered self-illuminating pixels for a more precise and brighter picture than ever before.6

Intelligently enhanced colour expression
Colour Booster Pro transforms the way you experience TV by leveraging AI to intelligently enhance colour expression, making each scene more vivid and dynamic.7

Get smooth motion for games up to 120Hz
Level up your gaming experience with exceptional motion enhancements up to 120Hz VRR. Providing crisp visuals at high speeds, unlock peak performance in every round.8 HDMI 2.1 compatibility provides access to ultra-high bandwidth for compatible devices, helping you keep ahead of the competition.8

Easily discover and access your games from one screen
Save time and speed up the game selection process.9 Stream over 100 blockbuster games with Xbox Game Pass or access other cloud gaming services – no downloads and console required.10 Plus, find your console gaming and standalone apps like YouTube, Spotify, Twitch & Discord all in one place.9

Tear free, stutter free, low latency HDR gaming
Built on AMD FreeSync™ core technology to reduce stutter and screen tearing, FreeSync Premium provides a true HDR gaming experience. It produces exceptional high dynamic range visuals while maintaining low latency for effortlessly smooth gameplay.11

Personalise your screen experience
Explore endless entertainment with your favourite apps in one place. With automated content curation you can spend less time searching and more time streaming the movies, games and shows you love.12 Your experience is also secured by Samsung Knox across SmartThings devices. Plus, One UI Tizen will support Tizen OS upgrades for the next 7 years.13

Monitor energy consumption
Easily monitor your power consumption by activating AI Energy Mode. This feature automatically detects and analyses surrounding light levels and usage behaviours to adjust the brightness if required.14

An incredible Dolby Atmos experience
Enjoy incredible sound with Dolby Atmos support to deliver larger-than-life audio experiences.15

title: Monster 1 Socket Surge Protector (Black)
body_html:
Introducing the Monster single outlet appliances surge protector - the ultimate solution for protecting your valuable appliances from power surges and voltage spikes. With a 700 joule rating and fireproof MOV technology, this surge protector is designed to effectively absorb and redirect excess voltage away from your appliances, preventing damage and prolonging their lifespan. The LED surge indicator light lets you know that your devices are protected and gives you peace of mind. But that's not all - this surge protector also comes with a remarkable $10,000 connected equipment warranty. With this warranty, you can rest assured that your appliances are covered in case of damage due to power surges. Don't risk damaging your appliances - protect them with the Monster single outlet appliances surge protector.

Why do I need a Surge Protector
A surge protector is an electrical device designed to protect your electronic devices from power surges or voltage spikes. Power surges can occur due to lightning strikes, power outages, or fluctuations in the electrical grid. Without a surge protector, these power surges can cause damage to your electronic devices, including your computer, TV, and other appliances. A surge protector helps to absorb and redirect the excess voltage away from your devices, protecting them from damage. Additionally, surge protectors can also prevent electrical fires and increase the lifespan of your electronic devices. In summary, using a surge protector can help protect your electronic devices from power surges and increase their lifespan, ultimately saving you money in the long run.

Overview

Bring all your entertainment to life with the extraordinarily realistic sound of Arc, the premium smart soundbar for TV, movies, music, and more. Surround yourself in the story with 3D sound from Dolby Atmos, and enjoy control with your TV remote, your voice, the Sonos app, and Apple AirPlay 2.

Set Arc in front of a standing TV or mount to the wall with a custom-designed wall mount*. A simple connection through HDMI eARC or ARC keeps setup simple whilst enabling high-quality audio playback.

title: Belkin Connect 4-Outlet Surge Protector with Dual USB-C 30W
body_html:
Protect the life of your electronics and appliances with 525 joules of surge protection from its 2m cable, 4 AC outlets and two fast charging USB-C PD ports. This product is rigorously tested for quality and features a Belkin 11-point safety system and best-in-class $40,000 Connected Equipment Warranty* for added peace of mind.

Key Features

525 joules of surge protection.
Reduce the risk of damage and increase the lifespan of your electronics and appliances with industry-leading protection. Our surge protector absorbs 525vjoules of energy to keep your home safe from power spikes.

Power Delivery and dynamic PPS technology.
The USB-C ports offer Power Delivery charging to compatible devices, so you’ll charge faster than using standard USB-A ports. Onboard PPS (Programmable Power Supply) technology detects the connected device and negotiates the optimal amount of power needed for an ideal fast charge.

Dual USB-C ports.
Two USB-C ports provide you with convenient expansion and flexibility for when you’re missing a power brick. You’ll have up to 30W of power shared across the two ports to fast charge smartphones and many other devices.

2m power cord and built-in wall mounts.
The 2m power cord allows for easy placement under a desk or behind appliances. Plus, built-in mounting holes give you the flexibility to hang, mount, or attach your surge protector where you need it.

Protected by an 11-point safety system.
Your device is plugged into a protector that offers overvoltage, over-temperature, overload, over-current, short-circuit and clamping voltage defence. It offers 3-line AC protection (ground, neutral, and line) and is made from material that passes a Glow Wire Test at 850℃. An indicator light shows when surge protection is active, and a warning light shows when the power coming through is not grounded.

Know you’re protected at a glance.
Built-in indicator light shows you that your protection is active and working, and lets you know if it’s time to change your surge protector. A recessed power switch offers security against accidental shut off.

Stay protected with our best-in-class Connected Equipment Warranty.
Use your electronics with confidence, supported by our best-in-class warranty.

*Belkin will repair or replace electronic devices damaged by an electrical charge while properly connected to this charger, up to $40,000AU. Visit belkin.com/cew for details.

Important: Be sure to regularly check the light on your surge protector. If the light is not on, the surge protector may have absorbed excess voltage from an event such as a thunderstorm or power outage. It may no longer be protecting equipment that is connected to it, and you should immediately replace it with a new surge protector. If you use the surge protector when the light is not on, your warranty will be invalidated. In any case, we recommend replacing a surge protector after three years of use, even if the light continues to come on.

title: Bose TV Speaker
body_html:
The Bose TV Speaker is a small soundbar that clarifies speech and improves overall TV sound. Designed with simplicity in mind, a single connection to your TV has you up and running in no time. And with Bluetooth® compatibility, you can wirelessly stream your favourite music or podcasts.

Hear your TV better
The Bose TV Speaker is a small soundbar that clarifies speech and improves overall TV sound. Inside there are two full-range drivers angled for wide, spatial sound, while the centre tweeter specifically focuses on clarifying speech.

Designed for simplicity
This small soundbar stands at just over 5 cm tall and can fit just about anywhere. And small LED lights on the front indicate when certain features are enabled.

More clarity
In dialogue mode, the Bose TV Speaker analyses what you’re watching to further elevate centre vocals, so you can hear and understand every word more clearly. Simply press the “dialogue mode” button on the included remote to enable.

More music
The Bose TV Speaker also has Bluetooth® compatibility, so you can listen to what you want, when you want. Press the “Bluetooth” button on the included remote to pair a device and wirelessly play music, podcasts, and more through your soundbar.

More bass
And while the Bose TV Speaker delivers surprisingly rich and deep sound for a soundbar of its size, you can press the BASS button on the remote for some added depth.

Easy to set up. Easy to use
A single connection to your TV via an optical audio cable (included) or an HDMI cable (sold separately) has your Bose TV Speaker up and running in no time. And with HDMI-CEC, your TV and soundbar can communicate when they are connected by an HDMI cable. When you turn the TV on, the soundbar will automatically turn on too, and you can even continue using your current TV remote to control the volume of the soundbar.

Add more, anytime
If you’re looking for more bass or want to expand your system, you can add a wired subwoofer for more theatre-quality home theatre sound. The Bose TV Speaker is compatible with the Bose Bass Module 500 and 700 (Bose Bass Module Connection Cable sold separately).

Key Features

Delivers overall improved TV sound and clear speech

Dialogue mode further elevates centre vocals

Bluetooth® compatibility

HDMI-CEC technology

Built-in Dolby decoding

title: Bose Smart Ultra Soundbar with Dolby Atmos (Arctic White)
body_html:
Introducing the top-of-the-line surround sound Bose soundbar for TV that’s here to immerse you completely in the heart of all your favourite content. The Bose Smart Ultra Soundbar for TV with Dolby Atmos and Bose TrueSpace technology separates music, dialogue and effects, and places them in different parts of a room for a truly immersive spatial audio experience like you’ve never heard before. Having a hard time hearing what your favourite characters are saying? AI Dialogue Mode automatically balances voice and surround sound for ultra-crisp vocal clarity. Plus, two upward-firing dipole speakers work with Bose technologies to make it feel like your space is filled with sound from every direction – even overhead.

Immersion no matter what you’re watching. 
The Bose Smart Ultra Soundbar system is equipped with Dolby Atmos and Atmos-encoded content. And for content that hasn’t been created in Dolby Atmos, TrueSpace technology works its magic to make your content feel like it’s coming from all around you. Even old school films, TV shows and games sound new again.

Ultra-crisp dialogue clarity. 
Having a hard time hearing what your favourite characters are saying? AI Dialogue Mode balances voice and surround sound for ultra-crisp vocal clarity.
 
You’ve never heard it like this before.  
With six full-range transducers, including two custom-engineered upward firing dipole speakers, a centre tweeter and speaker arrays, the Bose Smart Ultra Dolby Atmos Soundbar envelops you in sound from every direction.

Just plug and play it.  
The Bose Smart Ultra Soundbar uses a single connection to your TV. Choose the HDMI eARC connection or the optical audio connection (both cables provided). Simply connect the Bose soundbar to power and download the Bose Music app to your mobile device to complete the setup.
 
Private – or party – listening.   
With Bose SimpleSync, pair your Bose Smart Ultra Soundbar with select Bose headphones for a personal listening experience. Or group your soundbar with other Bose Bluetooth speakers and soundbars for a seamless, audio experience throughout your home. Connect at the press of a button.

Say it. Watch it. 
The Bose Smart Ultra Soundbar has Alexa built in. With Bose Voice4Video technology, your Alexa can do even more. Take control of your soundbar, TV, cable and satellite box with just your voice. You can turn on your TV and switch inputs between all your connected devices using just your voice. 
 
Stream anything.  
With Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Apple AirPlay 2, Spotify Connect and Chromecast, you can wirelessly stream whatever you love, however you want. Play your favourite ’90s tunes or obscure YouTube videos. If you can get it on your device, you can hear it through the Bose Smart Ultra Soundbar. 
 
Music. From room to room. 
Group your Bose Smart Ultra Soundbar system with other Bose smart speakers and soundbars over Wi-Fi for a seamless surround sound system throughout your home. Play different songs in different rooms or sync the same song across multiple rooms.

Surround Sound. Cinematic immersion.
Now you can pair the Bose Ultra Open Earbuds (sold separately) with your soundbar for an added dimension to your films and TV. Using a unique open-ear design and breakthrough Bose Immersive Audio, they act as rear surround speakers for the individual user to add another rich layer to the sonic experience your soundbar delivers. And because they’re from Bose, you’ll enjoy the deep, rich (and in this case, personal) sound you need to feel the onscreen action.

Control. At your fingertips.
With the Bose Music app, you can set up your soundbar, choose a voice assistant and set up Voice4Video, a Bose technology that expands your Alexa voice assistant control capabilities so you can control your soundbar, TV, cable or satellite box with just your voice.

Looks good in your home.  
Premium materials. Solid construction. Refined finishes. Clever controls. All carefully considered to create a soundbar that looks as beautiful as it sounds. 
 
Voice control at your command.  
Soundbar with voice control. Control your entertainment, daily tasks, and access information effortlessly using your voice with Amazon Alexa and Google Assistant. Its noise-rejecting microphones ensure clear voice recognition from any direction, even in noisy environments.

Bose Smart Ultra Soundbar vs Bose Smart Soundbar 600
The Bose Smart Ultra Soundbar is our top-of-the-line, most immersive soundbar. It delivers spatial audio like you’ve never heard before. The Bose Smart Soundbar 600 offers similar features with shockingly immersive sound for its size.

Key Features

Supports Dolby Atmos® and Atmos-encoded content

Bose TrueSpace provides immersive sound even from content not encoded with Dolby Atmos®

Bose AI Dialogue Mode for ultra-crisp vocal clarity

Compatible with Bose speakers and headphones using Bose’s SimpleSync technology

Personal Surround Sound – Enhance your experience using Bose Ultra Open Earbuds (sold separately)

Control soundbar with Voice, App or included remote

Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Apple Airplay 2, Spotify Connect and Chromecast enabled

ADAPTiQ room tuning

Works with other select Bose speakers over Wi-Fi for more music in more rooms

Optional bass module and rear surround speakers available

Amazon Alexa built in

Works with Google Assistant capabilities with compatible Google devices

Single connection to your TV

HDMI eARC and optical audio cables included

Includes remote

title: Sony HTA3000 250W 3.1 Channel Dolby Atmos Soundbar
body_html:
Immersive surround sound from a Compact Soundbar
Using three inbuilt front speakers, two front facing subwoofers and virtual height channels this compact and punchy soundbar delivers a wide and natural sound field from a combination of advanced hardware and next generation spatial sound technologies.

360 Spatial Sound customised to your environment when used with optional rear speakers
Part of Sony’s premium A Series soundbar collection, the HT-A3000 boasts Sony’s unique 360 Spatial Sound Mapping technology which creates multiple phantom speakers from just the soundbar and optional rear speakers. These phantom speakers are automatically arranged to create the optimal sound field for your specific space providing multi-dimensional sound – just like the sound heard at the cinema.

Cinematic Dolby Atmos Experience
The three front speakers allow you to enjoy the real thrill of Dolby Atmos/ DTS:X as each voice, instrument and sound is mapped in its own space within the 3D sound field. Enjoy an unparalleled spatial sound experience with realistic overhead effects for the ultimate home theatre experience.

Precise and Immersive Sound with BRAVIA Acoustic Center Sync
When Paired with BRAVIA XR TVs, the HT-A3000 brings you an immersive audio-visual experience combining the best sound and picture quality. When connected via Acoustic Center Sync- using the supplied cable – centre channel sound is delivered from both the soundbar and the TV, as opposed to just the soundbar. This allows you to enjoy accurate sound placement as dialogue is delivered directly from the screen.

Works with Google Assistant, Amazon Alexa and Apple Airplay 2
Sound made simple – stream directly from your smartphone via Bluetooth or Wi-Fi using Chromecast or Apple Airplay 2. You can also enjoy simple voice control as the HT-A3000 is compatible with both Google Assistant and Alexa enabled devices.

Customise your set up
Flexibility that allows you to build a full home cinema system that suits your needs and environment. Add an optional subwoofer to your soundbar to create more dramatic sound. The in-built subwoofer will focus on bass and vocals while the optional sub handles low range sounds for maximum impact in movies and music. Add optional wireless rear speakers to create the ultimate surround experience and enjoy Sony’s 360 Spatial Sound Mapping. Sony recommends the SASW3 subwoofer and SARS3S rear speakers.

Key Features

Enjoy the thrill of Dolby Atmos and DTS:X from a combination of 5 in-built speakers that reproduce up to 7.1.2ch sound

Immersive 360 Spatial Sound customised to your environment- available when connecting optional rear speakers

A perfect partner to BRAVIA XR TVs - with Acoustic Center Sync and integrated settings menu

Easily stream content with Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, Chromecast built-in, Spotify Connect and Apple Airplay 2

Seamlessly integrates with Google Assistant and Amazon Alexa devices

Customise your setup with optional wireless subwoofer and rear speakers to enhance your home theatre experience. Sony recommends the compact SASW3 subwoofer and wireless SARS3S rear speakers

*Wireless Subwoofer and rear speakers sold separately

title: Bose Smart Ultra Soundbar with Dolby Atmos (Black)
body_html:
Introducing the top-of-the-line surround sound Bose soundbar for TV that’s here to immerse you completely in the heart of all your favourite content. The Bose Smart Ultra Soundbar for TV with Dolby Atmos and Bose TrueSpace technology separates music, dialogue and effects, and places them in different parts of a room for a truly immersive spatial audio experience like you’ve never heard before. Having a hard time hearing what your favourite characters are saying? AI Dialogue Mode automatically balances voice and surround sound for ultra-crisp vocal clarity. Plus, two upward-firing dipole speakers work with Bose technologies to make it feel like your space is filled with sound from every direction – even overhead.

Immersion no matter what you’re watching. 
The Bose Smart Ultra Soundbar system is equipped with Dolby Atmos and Atmos-encoded content. And for content that hasn’t been created in Dolby Atmos, TrueSpace technology works its magic to make your content feel like it’s coming from all around you. Even old school films, TV shows and games sound new again.

Ultra-crisp dialogue clarity. 
Having a hard time hearing what your favourite characters are saying? AI Dialogue Mode balances voice and surround sound for ultra-crisp vocal clarity.
 
You’ve never heard it like this before.  
With six full-range transducers, including two custom-engineered upward firing dipole speakers, a centre tweeter and speaker arrays, the Bose Smart Ultra Dolby Atmos Soundbar envelops you in sound from every direction.

Just plug and play it.  
The Bose Smart Ultra Soundbar uses a single connection to your TV. Choose the HDMI eARC connection or the optical audio connection (both cables provided). Simply connect the Bose soundbar to power and download the Bose Music app to your mobile device to complete the setup.
 
Private – or party – listening.   
With Bose SimpleSync, pair your Bose Smart Ultra Soundbar with select Bose headphones for a personal listening experience. Or group your soundbar with other Bose Bluetooth speakers and soundbars for a seamless, audio experience throughout your home. Connect at the press of a button.

Say it. Watch it. 
The Bose Smart Ultra Soundbar has Alexa built in. With Bose Voice4Video technology, your Alexa can do even more. Take control of your soundbar, TV, cable and satellite box with just your voice. You can turn on your TV and switch inputs between all your connected devices using just your voice. 
 
Stream anything.  
With Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Apple AirPlay 2, Spotify Connect and Chromecast, you can wirelessly stream whatever you love, however you want. Play your favourite ’90s tunes or obscure YouTube videos. If you can get it on your device, you can hear it through the Bose Smart Ultra Soundbar. 
 
Music. From room to room. 
Group your Bose Smart Ultra Soundbar system with other Bose smart speakers and soundbars over Wi-Fi for a seamless surround sound system throughout your home. Play different songs in different rooms or sync the same song across multiple rooms.

Surround Sound. Cinematic immersion.
Now you can pair the Bose Ultra Open Earbuds (sold separately) with your soundbar for an added dimension to your films and TV. Using a unique open-ear design and breakthrough Bose Immersive Audio, they act as rear surround speakers for the individual user to add another rich layer to the sonic experience your soundbar delivers. And because they’re from Bose, you’ll enjoy the deep, rich (and in this case, personal) sound you need to feel the onscreen action.

Control. At your fingertips.
With the Bose Music app, you can set up your soundbar, choose a voice assistant and set up Voice4Video, a Bose technology that expands your Alexa voice assistant control capabilities so you can control your soundbar, TV, cable or satellite box with just your voice.

Looks good in your home.  
Premium materials. Solid construction. Refined finishes. Clever controls. All carefully considered to create a soundbar that looks as beautiful as it sounds. 
 
Voice control at your command.  
Soundbar with voice control. Control your entertainment, daily tasks, and access information effortlessly using your voice with Amazon Alexa and Google Assistant. Its noise-rejecting microphones ensure clear voice recognition from any direction, even in noisy environments.

Bose Smart Ultra Soundbar vs Bose Smart Soundbar 600
The Bose Smart Ultra Soundbar is our top-of-the-line, most immersive soundbar. It delivers spatial audio like you’ve never heard before. The Bose Smart Soundbar 600 offers similar features with shockingly immersive sound for its size.

Key Features

Supports Dolby Atmos® and Atmos-encoded content

Bose TrueSpace provides immersive sound even from content not encoded with Dolby Atmos®

Bose AI Dialogue Mode for ultra-crisp vocal clarity

Compatible with Bose speakers and headphones using Bose’s SimpleSync technology

Personal Surround Sound – Enhance your experience using Bose Ultra Open Earbuds (sold separately)

Control soundbar with Voice, App or included remote

Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Apple Airplay 2, Spotify Connect and Chromecast enabled

ADAPTiQ room tuning

Works with other select Bose speakers over Wi-Fi for more music in more rooms

Optional bass module and rear surround speakers available

Amazon Alexa built in

Works with Google Assistant capabilities with compatible Google devices

Single connection to your TV

HDMI eARC and optical audio cables included

Includes remote

WHAT’S IN THE BOX

Bose Smart Ultra Soundbar
HDMI eARC cable
Optical cable
ADAPTiQ headset
Power cord
Remote control (battery included)

Experience the pinnacle of Samsung picture quality, with Quantum Matrix Technology Pro powered by Quantum Mini LED, superb 8K Upscaling1, and beautiful Infinity Display on QN900C Neo QLED TV.

A whole new world of detail

The powerful Neural Quantum Processor 8K with deep learning is the brains behind your awesome viewing experience. It helps adapt and upscale the content frame-by-frame to suit your TV and viewing conditions, so that your screen delivers an incredible picture.6

title: Sony BRAVIA HTA8000 Theatre Bar 8 Soundbar
body_html:
Key Features

Enjoy cinematic moments together
New 360 Spatial Sound Mapping technology with 11 speaker units delivers immersive surround sound to a wider area, so everyone can share the experience.

Cinematic sound for a wider audience
BRAVIA Theatre Bar 8 combines physical and phantom speakers, creating a wider surround sound field that covers more of the room.

Makes everywhere the best seat
It doesn’t matter which seat you’re in. It doesn’t even matter what your room’s acoustics are like. Sound Field Optimization lets everyone experience movie theatre surround sound.

Outstanding acoustic performance with 11 speaker units
There’s more to great surround sound than signal processing alone. Your physical speakers need to deliver exceptional acoustic performance too – and BRAVIA Theatre Bar 8 doesn’t disappoint.

New 2-way speaker
Discover clear, wide surround sound from a single soundbar. The Bar 8 features a new 2-way speaker with added tweeters for front and centre, delivering wider surround sound and a precise sound image.

Quad woofer delivers powerful bass
The Bar 8 may be slim but it delivers remarkably powerful, punchy bass thanks to a built-in quad woofer.

Hear sound from overhead
Up-firing speakers reflect sound off the ceiling for immersive overhead audio. 360 Spatial Sound Mapping creates phantom ceiling speakers for even more atmospheric sound.

So easy to use
BRAVIA Theatre Bar 8 makes surround sound simple. From initial set-up to smartphone control, it's all about minimum effort, maximum enjoyment.

Do it all with BRAVIA Connect1
The BRAVIA Connect smartphone app guides you through initial settings, assists with troubleshooting, and lets you control volume, sound field and more. It also notifies you about software updates and lets you control a compatible TV too.2,3

Set up in seconds
Simply plug in the Bar 8, connect to your TV using HDMI, and power on. With LAN, HDMI IN and HDMI OUT (eARC), you’re all set to enjoy a new spatial surround sound experience.

Movies feel so real
With its HDMI 2.1 capability, BRAVIA Theatre Bar 8 ensures the original picture quality of any source is preserved, right up to 8K HDR.

An immersive gaming experience
Lose yourself in gaming. Enjoy immersive overhead sound with the PlayStation®5 console, optimised picture settings by Auto HDR Tone Mapping and Auto Genre Picture Mode when connecting compatible BRAVIA™ TVs and PS5® console. This product also supports VRR, ALLM and SBTM for more realistic gaming.4

Stream music from your favourite services
It's not all about movies. You can also enjoy music in high-quality upmixed sound. Built-in support for Spotify Connect™ and Apple AirPlay lets you play all your favourite tracks.

Bluetooth® connection5
Stream audio content wirelessly. Bluetooth® technology makes it easy to enjoy music, podcasts and more from your smartphone, tablet or laptop.

title: Philips PicoPix MaxTV Portable Projector with Android TV
body_html:
The PicoPix Max TV is a handy little nugget you’ll wonder how you ever did without. This superlative portable projector meets all expectations. With Android TV, your projector is the key to entering a full interactive entertainment universe. Thanks to the super bright 4 channel LEDs, you can project an image up to 120” in Full HD 1080p! If you don’t have time to finish your episode or find yourself on the move, the good news is that you can rely on a battery that lasts for up to 4 hours. With its auto focus, 4 corner correction, digital zoom and auto-keystone, you can enjoy a pixel perfect, crystal clear video wherever you're projecting. Always mobile? Thanks to its light sensor, the PicoPix Max TV automatically adjusts the brightness according to the available ambient light. The USB Type-C ports deliver fast data, audio, video and quick charging! You can connect your laptops, smartphones or tablets and simply enjoy. Thanks to Google Cast, go big and wirelessly cast your screen directly from any Android, iOS, Windows or MacOS device! Rated to last 30,000 hours, the PicoPix Max TV light source will display amazing, vivid graphics for years to come. PicoPix Max TV comes with an incredible built-in 2x12 watts stereo speakers for a truly immersive cinematic experience with a strong, precise sound. You can even use it as a Bluetooth speaker to listen your favourite tunes even if the projector is off!

True Full HD 1080p resolution
Native 1080p Full HD resolution from such a compact product means you no longer have to choose between a portable projector and high resolution. With the PicoPix MaxTV, you can watch all your favourite movies, TV shows or play games on a massive 120” with best-in-class resolution. The completely re-designed cooling system and 4 LED channels deliver incredible brightness that's 15% superior to Max, dramatically improving the contrast and avoiding washed out images.

Mind-blowing sound
Immerse yourself with ultra powerful sound, surround and bass boost. The sound is professionally tuned by a golden ear for a well balanced and perfect music or cinema playback. You can also use it as an external Bluetooth speaker via the dedicated Bluetooth button. Additionally, you get an astounding audio-visual experience and incredible sound quality right out of the box thanks to the built-in DSP.

Xtreme Portability
An ultra-compact PicoPix Max TV projector packed with everything you need. Make the most of a 4-hour battery in projection mode or 10 hours in Bluetooth Speaker mode. The Powerbank function will also charge all your devices via the USB-C or USB-A port.

Supercharged Image
Place the projector wherever you wish! Auto keystone and 4 corner correction help to eliminate crooked and distorted images for a perfectly proportioned picture even if the device is not straight in front of the wall. It also gives users an optimal image from virtually any angle and eliminates many of the hassles of an optimal set-up. Big space, small wall? No worries! The digital zoom can maximize the image size even if your projector is far away from the wall. Thanks to the 1.2 throw ratio, small spaces get a bigger picture. Max TV requires as little as 3.2m to project stunning 120” pictures.

Smart Autofocus
One-click auto-focus eliminates the hassle and burden of a manual set-up. The high-resolution camera and AI driven autofocus, will always ensure you get the clearest image, automatically.

Automatic Brightness
With the Auto Brightness feature, you won’t even need to adjust the projector if the room becomes brighter or darker! The light sensor analyses the room light in real time and automatically tunes the brightness of the PicoPix Max TV.

Texas Instrument Cinema DLP
Texas Instrument cinema technology delivers vivid pictures, deep contrast and a bright image in any conditions. You can expect an unrivalled visual experience with vibrant colours that deliver 100% of the REC709 signal.

Built-in Android TV
Your Philips Android TV Projector gives you the content you want—when you want it. You can customise the home screen to display your favourite apps, making it effortless to start streaming the movies and shows you love or pick up where you left off. Powered by the fastest AMLOGIC CPU, the PicpIx Max TV provides a smooth, best in class Android TV experience.

OK Google Ready
Want to play a game, watch Netflix or find content and apps in the Google Play store? Just tell your projector. You can even command all Google Assistant-compatible smart home devices, for example, dimming the lights and setting the thermostat on movie night.

ChromeCast Built-in
Chromecast built-in is a technology that allows you to stream your favourite entertainment and apps from your phone, tablet, or laptop right to your TV or speakers. Your phone acts as a simple, powerful remote. Just open the mobile apps you already know and love to quickly access your TV shows and playlists. No new log-ins or downloads required. You can use your phone to search, browse, queue and control the projector from anywhere in the home, and keep using it without disrupting what’s playing or draining your battery.

Fully Connected
Connect all your favourite devices via HDMI (like smartphone, tablet, laptop, gaming console) or USB-C Video and play all your videos, pictures and audio files from USB thanks to the built-in multimedia player. The Wi-fi MIMO Dual Band technology reduces buffering and is ideal for online gaming or watching Full HD movies.

Lens Protection
The lens cover ensures a complete protection of the lens during transportation.

Key Features

120" in True FULL HD 1080p

Xtreme sound and portability

Android TV experience

Bluetooth boombox function

Up to 4hrs Battery Life

Micro-USB chargeable 5V 2A

title: Hisense TriChroma Laser Cinema PX3 4K Ultra Short Throw Smart Projector
body_html:
The Revolutionary TriChroma LPU™ Digital Laser Engine reproduces stunning colours, brightness, and image clarity. Combined with our Total HDR Solution, PX3 creates breath-taking, detailed, and lifelike visuals, setting a new standard in home cinema excellence. As the world’s first Xbox-certified ultra-short-throw projector, PX3 ensures the ultimate gaming experience with seamless compatibility, low latency, and optimal visuals. Harmon Kardon’s award-winning sound system completes an immersive audio-visual entertainment experience.

Key Features

LPU™ Digital Laser Engine
Immerse yourself in the brilliance of Hisense LPU™ Technology’s advanced pure triple laser light source (Red, Blue, and Green). Our Pro Laser Engine delivers ultra-realistic colours and unparalleled immersion, boasting a super wide colour gamut and exceptional colour accuracy. Coupled with real-time Pro AI Algorithms that enhance brightness, fine-tune contrast, and eliminate noise, you’re in for a visual treat. It’s not just an upgrade, it’s a revolution in viewing experience, tailored to your love for vibrant and lifelike visuals.

Ultra Short Throw Technology
At mere inches from the wall, the laser console casts a massive projection in beautiful 4K resolution.

80"-150" Projection Size
Harness the power of Ultra Short Throw Technology with the PX3, designed to project vivid, lifelike images ranging from 80 to a colossal 150 inches. Simply position the console at the right distance from your wall to achieve the perfect picture size for your room. It’s all about maximising your viewing experience, no matter what the size of your room is.

Elevate Every Pixel
Hisense’s 4K AI Upscaler ensures everything from the old classics to modern streaming content receives a crystal-clear 4K makeover, turning the ordinary into extraordinary visual experiences.

Open Eyes to a Colourful Universe
Embark on a journey through a universe of unprecedented colour. Outperforming all other display technologies, we achieve a 110% BT.2020 colour gamut. Uncover the delicate nuances in skin tones, the azure expanse of the sky, and the blush of rosy cheeks, all in the richest and most realistic colours imaginable. Whether it’s cinematic masterpieces or breathtaking natural scenery, redefine your viewing experience with us.

Ultimate Black and White
Experience the strength of a 3000:1 native contrast. Dive into the depth of darker blacks and the brilliance of brighter whites, revealing an extensive contrast range that showcases the ultimate in black and white performance, guaranteeing delicate nuances during transitions. Say goodbye to blurred details and faded images; a sharper, more vibrant colour performance awaits you.

Every Corner Glitters
Dive into a world where lights sparkle and shadows intensify, brought to life by PX3’s adherence to multiple HDR standards. Witness every subtle detail hidden in the corners with perfect clarity, each frame harmoniously balanced with an impeccable 2800 ANSI Lumens Brightness. Dolby Vision takes this experience to new heights, amplifying the depth and richness of details, whether it’s the twinkle in an actor’s eye or the complex folds of a dark cloak. Engage with visuals that are layered, detailed, and strikingly true to life.
*Peak Brightness

Surround Your Senses
Immerse yourself in a unified Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos experience. Revel in the enhanced Dolby Vision, boasting superior HDR, richer colour depth, and sharper images, all powered by the Hisense Pro Laser Engine. Amplify your sensory journey with Dolby Atmos, designed to elevate your audio-visual experience effortlessly, as it intuitively optimises your entertainment.

Your game is meant to be big
The Xbox-certified gaming experience guarantees seamless compatibility, low latency, and optimal visuals. The product works beautifully with Xbox gaming consoles, giving the best gaming experience at a massive scale.

The Auto Low Latency Mode (ALLM) automatically reduces input lag by disabling unnecessary picture processing. MEMC can also be activated to enhance picture quality without increasing delay, delivering a blur-free experience.

Direct Sound for an Immersive Experience
Immerse yourself in a captivating auditory narrative with PX3 Front-Firing speakers. This innovative speaker design guarantees every sonic detail is directed straight at you, creating an encompassing, cinema-like experience right in the comfort of your own living room.

Brings You the Original
More than just a UST projector, it’s your personal home cinema. With Hisense’s Filmmaker Mode, transform your living room into a director’s vision. Experience films as they were meant to be seen, with true-to-life colour reproduction.

Buttery Smooth Motion
Experience lightning-fast processor response times of less than 6 microseconds, boosted by MEMC technology. Enjoy smooth and clear fast-moving images, making the Hisense Laser cinema perfect for sports, action-packed movies, gaming, and non-stop binge-watching.

Perfect Fit in Few Clicks
Place the PX3 within an appropriate position in front of the screen, active the auto keystone correction function to solve the problem of image and screen alignment which greatly makes PX3 simplicity use.

Connectivity for All your Gear
Easily connect all your audio/video gear to your Laser console – game consoles, cable boxes, speaker systems, you name it. The PX3 has modern ports and multiple connectivity options to be the hub for home entertainment.

Experience environmentally-friendly control at your fingertips.
Embrace the power of ambient light with Hisense’s Solar Powered Remote. Engineered to stay charged through both ambient light and a USB-C cable, this innovative design promotes an eco-friendly approach, reducing electronic waste and saving you money. Enhance your TV experience while contributing to a greener planet.

VIDAA OS
Welcome to the future of TV! Hisense's state-of-the-art operating system seamlessly unifies your favourite international and local content, tailored to your unique preferences and easy to find. Immerse yourself in a world of endless entertainment, featuring top-rated shows, blockbuster movies, and more – all personalised and conveniently accessible. Upgrade your viewing experience today and take control of your entertainment options!

Designed for longevity
Enjoy 25,000+ hours of entertainment. That’s over 10,000 movies, or over 18 years if you were to watch for 4 hours every single day!

body_html:
Key Features

NQ4 AI Gen2 Processor
This processor uses the power of 20 AI neural networks to optimise picture and sound quality. The result is superb performance, whether you're watching streaming services, playing your favourite video games or watching live sports.1

4K AI Upscaling
Watch your favourite content in brilliant detail. Our AI processor can take content and enhance it up to 4K resolution with 20 AI neural networks all while maintaining sharp and smooth picture quality.2

OLED HDR
Samsung's processor analyses each scene and boosts for brightness. The result is a beautifully bright screen with incredible contrast, which brings hidden details to light.3

PANTONE Validated
As a trusted symbol of colour fidelity by industry experts, ‘PANTONE Validated' certifies the accurate expression of 2,140 PANTONE colours and 110 newly added skin tone shades. So you can be sure that you're getting a rich, true to life viewing experience.4

Settings that intelligently optimise picture and sound
AI Mode offers a quick access menu to adjust adaptive picture and sound settings, intelligently optimising your TV experience to the surroundings and the content you're watching.

Sound that adjusts to your surroundings & content
Experience sound just as the creators intended, with clear voices and vivid, balanced tones. Your TV's AI processor recognises different sounds and optimises them based on characteristics of both the room and audio content, before ultimately refining them with audio remastering technology.5

Samsung OLED Technology uses Self Illuminating Pixels and RGB Sub-Pixels.
Experience deep blacks, clean whites and vibrant colours with OLED. Utilising over 8 million specially engineered self-illuminating pixels for a more precise and brighter picture than ever before.6

Intelligently enhanced colour expression
Colour Booster Pro transforms the way you experience TV by leveraging AI to intelligently enhance colour expression, making each scene more vivid and dynamic.7

Get smooth motion for games up to 120Hz
Level up your gaming experience with exceptional motion enhancements up to 120Hz VRR. Providing crisp visuals at high speeds, unlock peak performance in every round.8 HDMI 2.1 compatibility provides access to ultra-high bandwidth for compatible devices, helping you keep ahead of the competition.8

Easily discover and access your games from one screen
Save time and speed up the game selection process.9 Stream over 100 blockbuster games with Xbox Game Pass or access other cloud gaming services – no downloads and console required.10 Plus, find your console gaming and standalone apps like YouTube, Spotify, Twitch & Discord all in one place.9

Tear free, stutter free, low latency HDR gaming
Built on AMD FreeSync™ core technology to reduce stutter and screen tearing, FreeSync Premium provides a true HDR gaming experience. It produces exceptional high dynamic range visuals while maintaining low latency for effortlessly smooth gameplay.11

Personalise your screen experience
Explore endless entertainment with your favourite apps in one place. With automated content curation you can spend less time searching and more time streaming the movies, games and shows you love.12 Your experience is also secured by Samsung Knox across SmartThings devices. Plus, One UI Tizen will support Tizen OS upgrades for the next 7 years.13

Monitor energy consumption
Easily monitor your power consumption by activating AI Energy Mode. This feature automatically detects and analyses surrounding light levels and usage behaviours to adjust the brightness if required.14

An incredible Dolby Atmos experience
Enjoy incredible sound with Dolby Atmos support to deliver larger-than-life audio experiences.15

body_html:
Overview

This Crest Platinum Power Board is your best defence to protect your new TV or Computer. We’re so confident in the quality of our power board that we have included a 10-year warranty on the power board and a $150,000 connected equipment warranty to give peace of mind.

The Ultimate and Safest in Power Protection
The combination of our Fireproof Self-Tripping Metal Oxide Varistors (MOVs) with fast-acting thermal cut-outs, along with negative resistance componentry, protect your equipment from significant damage and potential fires that power issues such as surges can initiate.

Fireproof Self-Tripping MOVs
MOVs absorb excess energy caused by power issues such as surges and spikes. These events generate heat, and therefore the MOV is coupled with a sensitive thermal cut-out that will disconnect the circuit instantaneously. The MOVs and thermal cut-outs are encased in a heat resistant silicone compound and a fire-resistant enclosure to prevent fire.

TV and Data Surge Protection
Power spikes and surges can come over any wire, including the data transmission line and the TV antenna coaxial cable. Crest Platinum power boards protect your appliances against surges and other typical power issues.

Product and Connected Equipment Warranty
10 Year product warranty - If this product is found to be defective, Crest will replace the product free of charge. Up to $150,000 Connected Equipment Warranty - The Crest Company will replace or pay to repair the damage caused by excessive voltage to the equipment connected to this product.

title: Hisense 55" Q6NAU 4K QLED Smart TV [2024]
body_html:
The Q6NAU is packed with great features like Quantum Dot Colour for pure colours with stunning gradients, a 4K AI upscaler that works to upgrade your content to near-4k quality and Dolby Vision for an authentic movie experience with cinema’s leading technologies. The Series Q6NAU is sure to impress!

Key Features

Mastering perfection
With 4K content becoming increasingly more common, make sure you can watch your favourite movies, TV shows, and more the way they were meant to be seen, full of incredible depth and richness. Even with lower quality video, the Al upscaler analyses each frame, adjusting the pixels to produce the best 4k image possible, so even older content is brought to life before your eyes.

Billion+ shades of vivid colour
Quantum Dot TVs boast one of the most efficient technologies for bright, precise colour. By using quantum dots to emit extremely precise wavelengths of light, Quantum Dot Colour creates the possibility of witnessing billions of new shades at incredibly impressive levels of brightness. This all results in a significant colour volume for an array of colours that borders on the impossible.

Unlock smooth gameplay
Game Mode PLUS is your ticket to fluid, immersive gameplay. Boasting a 60Hz panel with variable refresh rate and low latency MEMC, it bridges the gap between graphics card and display. Say goodbye to lag and hello to a game that flows as smoothly as your skills.

See the contents dazzling details
Hisense TVs have taken the only sensible approach to HDR with support for all major formats, including Dolby Vision and HDR10+ Decoding. Never worry about subpar video quality or compatibility again. Simply choose and play whatever content you want, knowing you’re experiencing it in perfect detail, enhanced colours, and deeper blacks, thanks to the wide range of HDR formats.

Step into sound
Dolby Atmos® brings the missing layer of depth to TV audio, typically reserved for theatres. Leveraging technologies trusted by directors and sound mixers, this feature crafts a multi-dimensional sound environment right in your living room. Immerse yourself in spectacular entertainment with unmatched sound clarity and depth, all without extra equipment.

Stadium level entertainment
Al Sports Mode enables the best picture and audio quality for the smoothest viewing experience. See every crack in the field, the players determined stare, the excitement of everyone in the audience, and hear every note of the commentator’s voice. Hisense TVs intuitively sense and clean up and enhance fast-moving objects, for a perfectly fluid viewing experience.

The action, unblurred
Leverage MEMC and 3D Noise Reduction on a responsive 60Hz panel with Hisense’s Smooth Motion. This feature banishes those irritating blurs, as every intricate movement, every sudden twist, is displayed with crisp clarity, making dynamic scenes feel fluid and lifelike. Immerse yourself in unblemished action and savour every moment.

Al real-time scenario-specific optimisation
Let your TV do the work with the intelligent Al Picture optimisation software. Like the world’s greatest art critic, your TV will analyse the composition of each frame and adjust your brightness, resolution, colour settings, and more so that each scene looks perfect – and you don’t have to do anything but sit back, relax, and let your smart TV take care of everything.

Your voice, your command
The Hisense Voice Remote provides an alternative approach to interacting with your entertainment setup. With a high-quality built-in microphone, you can use the power of your voice to command your TV with the touch of a button. Pause, play, stop, rewind, fast forward, navigate between content, interact with your favourite virtual assistants, and more with one simple device.
*Remote ID differs by region.

Command your castle
Hisense TV works with Google Home to easily set up, control, and automate your connected devices, from almost anywhere. With Apple AirPlay, you can stream movies, music, games, and photos to your television right from your iPhone, iPad, or Mac. And because your television is compatible with Apple Home, you can control it on your iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, HomePod mini, or Mac using Apple Homekit technology.

Watch your movies and TV shows the way the filmmakers intended
Experience the message as it was intended with the Hisense Filmmaker Mode. Adjust your video to its original settings, to see details like the sound, aspect ratio, colour, frame rate, and more as it was originally envisioned for the most authentic display of your favourite filmmaker’s masterpiece, before it was altered for generic viewing.

Easy. Fast. Secure. Global and Local Entertainment.
With a faster, more customisable operating system, finding great entertainment fast has never been easier. Switch between apps and connected devices, receive recommendations and search thousands of shows across Netflix, YouTube, Prime Video, Disney+, Kayo, Foxtel, Stan iView, Freeview Plus and many more!

title: Belkin Connect 1-Outlet Surge Protector
body_html:
Protect the life of your most delicate electronics and appliances with 1,800 joules of surge protection. This product is rigorously tested for quality and features a Belkin 6-point safety system and best-in-class $30,000 Connected Equipment Warranty* for added peace of mind.

Key Features

Protect the life of your electronics and appliances.
Absorb 1,800 joules of excess energy to reduce the risk of damage to your connected devices.

You can never be too safe.
Protect your home as well as your electronic devices and appliances against power spikes and surges.

Stay protected with our best-in-class Connected Equipment Warranty.
Use your electronics with confidence, supported by our best-in-class warranty.

1,800 joules of Surge Protection.
Reduce the risk of damage and increase the lifespan of your electronics and appliances with industry-leading protection. Our surge protector absorbs 1,800 joules of energy to keep your home safe from power spikes.

Slim, Modern Design.
Built to fit into tight spaces, you can ensure your large electronic devices are safe and secure without the need for a big and bulky old-style strip. The compact and slim design makes it easy to place the protector wherever you need it.

Protected by 6-point safety system.
Your device is plugged into a protector that offers overvoltage and clamping voltage defence. It offers 3-line AC protection (ground, neutral, and line) and is made from material that passes a Glow Wire Test at 850℃. An indicator light shows when surge protection is active, and a warning light shows when the power coming through is not grounded.

Know you’re protected at a glance.
Built-in indicator light shows you that your protection is active and working, and lets you know if it’s time to change your surge protector.

*Belkin will repair or replace electronic devices damaged by an electrical charge while properly connected to this charger, up to $30,000AU. Visit belkin.com/cew for details.

Important: Be sure to regularly check the light on your surge protector. If the light is not on, the surge protector may have absorbed excess voltage from an event such as a thunderstorm or power outage. It may no longer be protecting equipment that is connected to it, and you should immediately replace it with a new surge protector. If you use the surge protector when the light is not on, your warranty will be invalidated. In any case, we recommend replacing a surge protector after three years of use, even if the light continues to come on.

Key Features

NQ4 AI Gen2 Processor
This processor uses the power of 20 AI neural networks to optimise picture and sound quality. The result is superb performance, whether you're watching streaming services, playing your favourite video games or watching live sports.1

4K AI Upscaling
Watch your favourite content in brilliant detail. Our AI processor can take content and enhance it up to 4K resolution with 20 AI neural networks all while maintaining sharp and smooth picture quality.2

OLED HDR
Samsung's processor analyses each scene and boosts for brightness. The result is a beautifully bright screen with incredible contrast, which brings hidden details to light.3

PANTONE Validated
As a trusted symbol of colour fidelity by industry experts, ‘PANTONE Validated' certifies the accurate expression of 2,140 PANTONE colours and 110 newly added skin tone shades. So you can be sure that you're getting a rich, true to life viewing experience.4

Settings that intelligently optimise picture and sound
AI Mode offers a quick access menu to adjust adaptive picture and sound settings, intelligently optimising your TV experience to the surroundings and the content you're watching.

Sound that adjusts to your surroundings & content
Experience sound just as the creators intended, with clear voices and vivid, balanced tones. Your TV's AI processor recognises different sounds and optimises them based on characteristics of both the room and audio content, before ultimately refining them with audio remastering technology.5

Samsung OLED Technology uses Self Illuminating Pixels and RGB Sub-Pixels.
Experience deep blacks, clean whites and vibrant colours with OLED. Utilising over 8 million specially engineered self-illuminating pixels for a more precise and brighter picture than ever before.6

Intelligently enhanced colour expression
Colour Booster Pro transforms the way you experience TV by leveraging AI to intelligently enhance colour expression, making each scene more vivid and dynamic.7

Get smooth motion for games up to 120Hz
Level up your gaming experience with exceptional motion enhancements up to 120Hz VRR. Providing crisp visuals at high speeds, unlock peak performance in every round.8 HDMI 2.1 compatibility provides access to ultra-high bandwidth for compatible devices, helping you keep ahead of the competition.8

Easily discover and access your games from one screen
Save time and speed up the game selection process.9 Stream over 100 blockbuster games with Xbox Game Pass or access other cloud gaming services – no downloads and console required.10 Plus, find your console gaming and standalone apps like YouTube, Spotify, Twitch & Discord all in one place.9

Tear free, stutter free, low latency HDR gaming
Built on AMD FreeSync™ core technology to reduce stutter and screen tearing, FreeSync Premium provides a true HDR gaming experience. It produces exceptional high dynamic range visuals while maintaining low latency for effortlessly smooth gameplay.11

Personalise your screen experience
Explore endless entertainment with your favourite apps in one place. With automated content curation you can spend less time searching and more time streaming the movies, games and shows you love.12 Your experience is also secured by Samsung Knox across SmartThings devices. Plus, One UI Tizen will support Tizen OS upgrades for the next 7 years.13

Monitor energy consumption
Easily monitor your power consumption by activating AI Energy Mode. This feature automatically detects and analyses surrounding light levels and usage behaviours to adjust the brightness if required.14

An incredible Dolby Atmos experience
Enjoy incredible sound with Dolby Atmos support to deliver larger-than-life audio experiences.15
