title: Samsung 98" QN90A Neo QLED 4K Smart TV
body_html:
Overview

Quantum Matrix Technology for brilliant blacks and next-level detail
Quantum Matrix Technology represents a revolution in TV display technology. By developing proprietary backlights shrunk to 1/40th of their size, and introducing a micro layer for precise light control, Samsung has set a new standard in picture quality, delivering next level detail, deeper blacks and brilliant brightness and contrast.*
*Compared to QLED Q80A. Picture quality will vary depending on quality and resolution of source content.

Unleash vivid colour with Quantum Dot
Samsung QLED TV's Quantum Dot technology delivers a world of immersive colours and contrast in a variety of lighting conditions - allowing you to discover details you haven’t before.

Experience audio in action with Object Tracking Sound +
Experience Samsung's groundbreaking sound technology that follows objects on screen. Dedicated up-firing and side-firing speakers are designed to create an immersive sound experience that puts you right in the middle of the action. *
*The quality of sound effects may vary depending on the source content, installation and environmental characteristics (e.g. ceiling).

Experience superb detail with Quantum HDR 32x
Watch your favourite films and shows in extraordinary detail. Quantum HDR 32X is designed to bring to life what you might have missed in particularly dark or light scenes, and makes them pop in vivid, breath-taking colour.
*The Range of Quantum HDR claims luminance based on internal testing standards and is subject to change according to viewing environment or specific conditions.

Enjoy TV without closing the blinds with Anti Glare Technology
Samsung’s Anti-Glare Technology helps you enjoy your TV in a variety of conditions, day or night - meaning you can enjoy the show. Ideal for Aussie conditions.
*Some glare may still be present depending on location of installation

Great view from virtually every seat
Wide Viewing Angle means you've got virtually the best seat, no matter where you are in the room. Delivering vibrant colour while maintaining detail, we’ve optimised your viewing experience from a variety of angles*.
*Compared to Samsung QLED Q80T TV and lower

A TV designed to be watched, not seen
The stylish NeoSlim design makes this Neo QLED TV the perfect complement to any home. At just 27mm thin, it boasts an incredibly thin profile that is designed to blend in seamlessly. And with no bulky bezels and built-in cable management to help reduce clutter, you can enjoy the action without distraction.

The TV that adapts to its surrounds with Intelligent Mode
Your QLED TV knows how to help create the very best entertainment experience. In fact, it is designed to make sure the action always looks and sounds incredible. Intelligent Mode uses a combination of smart sensors and Upscaling Technology to fine-tune the audio, picture and brightness, so it doesn’t matter who’s making noise next to you, or how dimmed the lights are, you’ll get incredible results.*
*Picture and sound quality of upscaled content will vary depending on quality and resolution of source content. Performance may vary depending on installation environment and surroundings.

Optimised picture in virtually any light
Adaptive Picture technology automatically adjusts your screen's brightness levels to suit the room you're watching it in. And because it helps optimise content, you can be sure your favourite shows are always looking incredible. *
*Picture quality may vary depending on quality and resolution of source content, installation and viewing conditions.

Never miss a word
Whatever’s going on during movie night, Active Voice Amplifier will make sure you never miss a word. It is designed to analyse the noise levels in your room and amplify the dialogue, so even if the dog’s barking or the kids are arguing, to help ensure you’ll hear every word of action.
*Performance may vary depending on installation environment and surroundings.

Makes what you're watching look its best*
Thanks to the power of AI upscaling, your TV is designed to upgrade your favourite content to 4K resolution. By helping to restore lost details, refine picture quality and reduce image noise, it'll make whatever you're watching look as good as possible.*
*Picture and sound quality of upscaled content will vary depending on quality and resolution of source content.

Turning blank into beautiful with Ambient Mode+
Beautifully integrate your TV's screen to suit your tastes and interior décor with Samsung’s Ambient Mode +. Display art, photos, time and weather or take a picture of the wall and set it on-screen, so your TV seamlessly blends in.*
*Ambient Mode + performance may vary depending on where the TV is installed including wall designs, patterns or colours.

Keep up with the action
Keep up with fast-paced sports and action movies. Samsung’s Motion Rate 200 helps you experience smooth, clear motion through the most dynamic of scenes.
*Compared to Samsung QLED 4K Smart TV Q60A.

Control multiple devices with one remote control*
Easily control all of your compatible devices with Samsung’s One Remote Control and get quick access to things like Netflix, YouTube, gaming consoles or a Soundbar with Smart Hub.*

And now, One Remote Control is partially made with recycled plastic** and is powered by indoor lights, so you'll never need disposable batteries again.
*Compatible only with selected devices. Please see samsung.com/au/oneremote. Internet required. Data and subscription charges may apply. Apps may be subject to change. ** Our One Remote Control contains about 24% recycled content.

Simple and seamless with Smart Connectivity
With Samsung you get a simple, yet powerful smart TV experience. Auto Device Detection**** helps you set up, while quick access and seamless switching lets you easily access your favourite apps, services and connected devices. Favourites include: Netflix, YouTube, Foxtel, Stan, Binge, Apple TV, Disney+ and catch-up TV.*
*Internet required. Data and subscription charges may apply. Apps may be subject to change without notice.
****Auto Device Detection is compatible with selected devices. Please see https://www.samsung.com/au/tvs/one-remote-device-list/

Works with
Samsung TV works with Amazon Alexa and Apple Airplay 2 so you can control your connected home your way.^
^Amazon, Alexa and all related logos are trademarks of Amazon.com, Inc. or its affiliates. Supported languages may differ between Bixby, Alexa.

Enjoy all the leading Apps*
Netflix, Amazon Prime, Disney+, Apple TV, Google Play, Kayo, YouTube, Foxtel, Stan, Binge, ABC iView, SBS On Demand, 7Plus, 9Now, 10Play*
*Internet required. Data and subscription charges may apply. Apps may be subject to change without notice.

Screen Mirroring
Wirelessly mirror the screen and audio from your smartphone, tablet or PC to your Samsung TV for maximum impact.**
**Feature is available on windows 10, Android 6.0 and higher mobile devices that support Mirror Casting and Apple devices supporting Apple AirPlay2. Available on Samsung Q60A model and up.

Multiview
Watch what's on your TV and your mobile on the same screen at the same time. Whether it's live stats for sports or video guides for games, simply connect your phone and multi-screen like never before.**
**Feature is available on Windows 10, Android 6.0 and higher mobile devices that support Mirror Casting and Apple devices supporting Apple AirPlay2. Available on Samsung Q60A model and up.

Auto Device Detection
Automatically detects and names compatible new devices. It gives you the option to add your device to your Home Menu for easy access when you need it.****
****Auto Device Detection is compatible with selected devices. Please see https://www.samsung.com/au/tvs/one-remote-device-list/

Bluetooth
With Bluetooth connectivity for your compatible devices, you can connect to your TV with less cables without moving from the comfort of your couch.

Control your TV with ease
You can ask either Bixby or Alexa to play your favourite content, get answers, and even control your TV and other compatible connected devices - all by using nothing more than your voice.*
*Content services are subject to change without notice. Voice commands recognise English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Chinese and Korean. Not all accents, dialects and expressions recognised. Supported languages may differ between Bixby and Alexa. Amazon, Alexa and all related logos are trademarks of Amazon.com, Inc. or its affiliates.

Game Ready
Advanced Game Mode is the ultimate gaming advantage. It helps ensure your TV and compatible console are working seamlessly together so you can see the action, move fast and enjoy total control over the action. It’s a winning combination and one that could take you to the top of the leader board, again and again.

Take your gaming to the next level with more control*
Real Game Enhancer turns your TV into a pure gaming machine. With low input lag* and enhanced picture quality, contrast and colour, it’s the winning combination that can take your gaming to the next level.
*Compared to Samsung AU8000 TV. Low input lag is measured based on internal testing conditions and is subject to change according to game setting or specific conditions.

Ready for next level gaming
Get ready to game with impressive 4K resolution at 120 frames per second. HDMI 2.1 compatibility allows for ultra-high bandwidth for compatible devices to keep you ahead of the competition and at the top of your game.*
*Picture quality will vary depending on quality and resolution of source content. 120fps is dependent on external source supporting HDMI 2.1

Ultrawide View for winning game play
Take on the competition and see more of the action with an ultra-wide field of vision. With a flexible (32:9 and 21:9) aspect ratio, you can dominate every battle and enjoy an immersive gaming experience. *
*Feature requires compatible PC and gaming title. Screen resolution change from external device may be required.

Take control of the action
Take control like never before and quickly access the settings that can take your game to the next level. The Game Bar will let you navigate to see whether the Variable Refresh Rate is activated and access every important feature you need at speed.

Immersive sound in perfect harmony with Q-Symphony
Experience ground breaking audio with Q-Symphony, which synchronises sound from both your TV with your compatible Samsung Q-Series Soundbar for a truly immersive surround sound experience that puts you right in the middle of the action.*
*Feature only available on AU8000, QLED and Neo QLED 2021 TVs when used with a Samsung Q-Series Soundbar. Soundbars sold separately. Audio quality varies based on source content, installation and environmental characteristics (e.g. ceiling).

Tailored Sound to fit your space
Tailors your TV sound to help ensure the audio is always optimised for the room it's in. By testing room reverberations, you can be sure your TV is always delivering an immersive performance.*
*Audio quality varies based on source content, installation and environmental characteristics (e.g. ceiling).

Intelligent, brilliant and beautiful.
Behind the Neo QLED TV's awesome picture quality and performance is the powerful Neo Quantum Processor 4K. It is responsible for a range of key features such as colour tone mapping and image upscaling, that helps ensure your screen always delivers movies and shows in incredible detail for a truly brilliant viewing experience.
*Viewing experience may vary according to the type of content, format and source. Upscaling may not apply to PC connection and Game Mode.

Free TV, no strings attached*
Enjoy free live streaming TV with Samsung TV Plus. With a variety of channels to choose from including news, sports, entertainment and more. It's 100% free and is ready to use without additional setup. All you need is an Internet connection.*
*Internet connection required. Add Data charges may apply. Apps or content may be subject to change.

We care so you're carefree

title: Samsung 65" QN85F NEO QLED 4K Mini LED Smart AI TV [2025]
body_html:
Key Features

NQ4 AI Gen2 Processor
This processor uses the power of 20 AI neural networks to optimise picture and sound quality. The result is superb performance, whether you're watching streaming services, playing your favourite video games or watching live sports.1

Quantum Matrix Technology Plus
Quantum Matrix Technology brings innovation to TV display technology. Using our proprietary Quantum Mini LEDs with precise light control, Samsung have enhanced picture quality, delivering incredible detail, deep blacks and brilliant contrast.2

Dolby Atmos®
Enjoy incredible sound with Dolby Atmos support to deliver larger-than-life audio experiences.3

Neo Quantum HDR
Watch your favourite films come to life in new detail with Neo Quantum HDR. Dynamic contrast and colour helps reveal what you might have missed in particularly dark or light scenes, delivering stunning scenes for you to enjoy.4

Settings that intelligently optimise picture and sound
AI Mode offers a quick access menu to adjust adaptive picture and sound settings, intelligently optimising your TV experience to the surroundings and the content you're watching.

Sound that adjusts to your surroundings & content
Experience sound just as the creators intended, with clear voices and vivid, balanced tones. Your TV's AI processor recognises different sounds and optimises them based on characteristics of both the room and audio content, before ultimately refining them with audio remastering technology.5

Boost shows and movies to 4K resolution
Watch your favourite content in brilliant detail. Our AI processor can take content and enhance it up to 4K resolution with 20 AI neural networks — all while maintaining sharp and smooth picture quality.6

Intelligently enhanced colour expression
Colour Booster Pro transforms the way you experience TV by leveraging AI to intelligently enhance colour expression, making each scene more vivid and dynamic.7

Sharpens and smooths the motion of objects and text with NQ4 AI Gen3 Processor
Our AI Gen3 processor leverages AI to sharpen and smooth out the motion of objects and text. This takes watching live sports and action movies to another level.8

Transform your content quality
Automatically upscale your standard dynamic range (SDR) content into high dynamic range (HDR-like) quality by using AI algorithms to deliver brighter highlights, more vibrant colours and clearer details.9

Enjoy a full range of authentic colours
As a trusted symbol of colour fidelity by industry experts, ‘PANTONE Validated' certifies the accurate expression of 2,140 PANTONE colours and 110 newly-added skin tone shades. So, you can be sure that you're getting a rich, true-to-life viewing experience.10

Get smooth motion for games up to 144Hz
Level up your gaming experience with exceptional motion enhancements up to 144Hz VRR. Providing crisp visuals at high speeds, unlock peak performance in every round.11 HDMI 2.1 compatibility provides access to ultra-high bandwidth for compatible devices, helping you keep ahead of the competition.11

Easily discover and access your games from one screen
Save time and speed up the game selection process.12 Stream over 100 blockbuster games with Xbox Game Pass or access other cloud gaming services – no downloads and console required.13 Plus, find your console gaming and standalone apps like YouTube, Spotify, Twitch & Discord all in one place.12

Tear free, stutter free, low latency HDR gaming
Built on AMD FreeSync™ core technology to reduce stutter and screen tearing, FreeSync Premium Pro provides an immersive HDR gaming experience. It produces exceptional high dynamic range visuals while maintaining low latency for effortlessly smooth gameplay.14

Optimise your gaming experience
Easily take control and quickly access and navigate settings that can take your game to the next level from the Game Bar.15

Virtual sound that tracks the action
Create a surround sound experience with virtual top-channel audio that follows the action so that you can be immersed in the audio.16

title: Sony HTG700 3.1ch 400W Soundbar with Wireless Subwoofer
body_html:
This 3.1ch Dolby Atmos®/ DTS:X™ soundbar couples powerful, immersive surround sound with crystal-clear dialogue—so you can lose yourself completely in your favourite TV and movies.

Key Features

Hear sound from all directions with up to 7.1.2 channel surround sound
Vertical Surround Engine, our advanced surround technology, lets you enjoy the thrill of the latest cinema audio formats like Dolby Atmos and DTS:X in a slim unit. Its three front speakers, combined with unique Sony signal processing, reproduce "vertical" surround, creating virtual surround sound that seems to come from all around you.

Everything upscaled close to 7.1.2ch
In a modern movie theatre there are speakers all around you, each with their finely tuned sounds, combining to make a fully immersive surround sound experience. Hit the Immersive AE (Audio Enhancement) button and the HT-G700 can upscale even regular stereo audio to 7.1.2 surround sound - so every TV show and movie gets the surround sound treatment.

Uplifted sound fts the height of your TV
Sound is fine-tuned to match the height of your TV by S-Force PRO. Now, even if your TV is bigger than 55 inches, it will sound like audio is coming from your TV screen, putting you deeper into everything you watch.

Wireless Subwoofer for rich, powerful bass
A powerful wireless subwoofer delivers a deeper, richer bass sound - and with simple wireless connection, where you place it is up to you.

Sound modes to match your entertainment
Select the sound or audio mode best suited to your entertainment with a direct key on your remote control. Go deeper into movies with Cinema mode and hear every detail of your favourite tracks in Music mode. Voice mode tailors sound settings to accentuate speech so you won't miss a word. And Night mode optimises the sound balance, so you can hear everything clearly even at low volume levels.

Easy connections
Connect a compatible TV or device wirelessly via Bluetooth technology, or use the HDMI eARC/ARC or optical digital input for full-bandwidth sound.

Enjoy all your movies in 4K HDR quality
With the latest 4K HDR 18Gbps pass through and HDCP2.2/HDCP2.3, the HT-G700 is made for the latest home cinema formats including Dolby Vision, HDR10 and Hybrid Log Gamma.

Wireless connectivity with your TV
Send audio wirelessly from your compatible Sony TV to your sound bar using Bluetooth technology.

One-cable HDMI eARC/ARC
Send audio and control information from your TV using just one cable with HDMI.

Stream with Bluetooth technology
Stream music wirelessly with Bluetooth technology.

title: Hisense C2 4K Trichroma Laser Mini Projector
body_html:
The Hisense C2 Laser Mini Projector goes beyond the ordinary projector, making it ideal for unforgettable movie nights indoors or outdoors. Its innovative gimbal design allows you to project content onto walls, ceilings, or virtually any surface in your home. Enjoy stunning 4K quality powered by a triple-colour laser and experience vivid, lifelike visuals with an impressive 2000 lumens of brightness. Whether you’re hosting a cozy night in or an outdoor screening, the C2 delivers an immersive viewing experience.

65" - 300" Super Wide Projection Size
Create the ultimate viewing experience. C2 adapts to any screen size from 65” to 300”, so you can project onto a wall in your living room or a gigantic screen in your backyard.

4K & 4K Upscaler
Bring what’s on-screen into crystal-clear focus. Our 4K AI Upscaler transforms beloved classics, home movies, broadcast TV and streaming content into striking 4K quality. It’s amazing what can happen when every pixel works even harder.

2000 Lumens
Experience what you’re watching in stunning 2000 lumens of brightness, bringing out every detail—from the deepest shadows to the brightest highlights. Your picture becomes even more captivating with enhanced vibrancy and clarity, delivering an immersive, vivid viewing experience.

Pure Triple Colour Laser
Enjoy stunning, true-to-life colours with the MCL38 Laser design. With its ability to achieve high brightness, this technology brings amazing depth and detail, making your favourite movies, games, and photos come to life!

Wide Colour Gamut
The C2 is capable of differentiating more unique colours spanning a larger range of the spectrum for a picture that’s more vibrant, vivid, and precise than ever before.

Dolby Vision
Get transported through the screen. Dolby Vision captures even the most subtle emotions flickering across the actor’s face during a dark night scene. Appreciate the cinema as the filmmakers intended.

Gimbal Design
Adjust your projector to your perfect viewing angle with a gimbal that can swing the machine 360° horizontally and 135° vertically. It’s a breeze to project movies both on a screen and ceiling.

Auto Magic Adjusting
The Hisense C2 projector offers a better viewing experience with its advanced features. It has auto keystone correction and auto screen fit for perfectly framed images, and autofocus for clear visuals. The projector also adjusts to your wall colour for smooth viewing. Plus, its eye protection feature reduces blue light and flicker to prevent eye strain. Enjoy a simple and immersive experience with the Hisense C2.

JBL Sound
The JBL sound system brings your movies to life with DTS Virtual X 3D surround sound. From the dialogue and soundtrack to the special effects, everything has never felt closer to you.

Smooth Gaming Experience
Immerse yourself in fast, high-intensity games without the distraction of blurry images or system stutters with automatic Game Mode. Dive in, and experience head-to-head gaming with minimal lag.
*DLP Turbo Mode will disable auto-correction features to provide the fastest gaming response

3D Mode
You cannot only hear immersive 3D sound but also see 3D visuals at the same time*. 3D Mode brings every scene to life, with room-filling sound design adding a tremendous sense of depth, realism and immersion to everything on display.
*DLP-link active shutter 3D glasses required

Connectivity
Connect all of your devices without a hitch. HDMI and USB ports enable you to sync up your gaming consoles, soundbars and more.

Key Features

4K & 4K Upscaler 65" - 300" Super Wide Projection Size

2000 ANSI Lumens Brightness

Auto Magic Adjusting System - auto keystone correction, auto screen fit, auto focus and wall colour adaption.

Pure Triple Colour Laser

Dolby Vision + 3D

JBL sound system and wide colour gamut

Theatre-like sound, perfectly matching pictures

Crystal clear voice. With AI technology.

Entertainment you love. With help from Google.

body_html:
Overview

This Crest Platinum Power Board is your best defence to protect your new TV or Computer. We’re so confident in the quality of our power board that we have included a 10-year warranty on the power board and a $75,000 connected equipment warranty to give peace of mind.

The Ultimate and Safest in Power Protection
The combination of our Fireproof Self-Tripping Metal Oxide Varistors (MOVs) with fast-acting thermal cut-outs, along with negative resistance componentry, protect your equipment from significant damage and potential fires that power issues such as surges can initiate.

Fireproof Self-Tripping MOVs
MOVs absorb excess energy caused by power issues such as surges and spikes. These events generate heat, and therefore the MOV is coupled with a sensitive thermal cut-out that will disconnect the circuit instantaneously. The MOVs and thermal cut-outs are encased in a heat resistant silicone compound and a fire-resistant enclosure to prevent fire.

TV and Data Surge Protection
Power spikes and surges can come over any wire, including the data transmission line and the TV antenna coaxial cable. Crest Platinum power boards protect your appliances against surges and other typical power issues.

Product and Connected Equipment Warranty
10 Year product warranty - If this product is found to be defective, Crest will replace the product free of charge. Up to $75,000 Connected Equipment Warranty - The Crest Company will replace or pay to repair the damage caused by excessive voltage to the equipment connected to this product.

Key Features

4 power sockets

Designed for the latest TVs and computers

Power, data and coaxial surge protection

240v surge protection up to 1,800 joules

Fireproof mov protection

Diagnostic lights immediately alert user

2 x USB, 2.4a max fast charging

title: Bose Solo Soundbar Series 2
body_html:
The Bose Solo Soundbar Series 2 is a compact Bluetooth® soundbar that makes every word easier to understand and gives you better sound from your TV with improved Dialogue Mode and built-in Dolby® decoding. Designed to be easy to use, with a single connection that has you up and running in no time. And with Bluetooth connectivity, you can wirelessly stream your favourite music or podcasts.

Key Features

Get better sound from your TV
The Bose Solo Soundbar Series 2 is a Bluetooth® TV speaker that makes every word easier to understand and gives you better sound from your TV with better voice clarity from the improved Dialogue Mode. Inside, there are two full-range drivers angled for wide, spatial sound.

Easy-to-use and compact Bluetooth® soundbar
This soundbar stands at just under 7 cm (3") tall and can fit under most TVs. A high-quality steel wall bracket is included to mount the soundbar flush to the wall. Easily mount your soundbar on the wall for a minimalist look and use the simplified remote for quick navigation. Small LED lights on the front indicate when certain features are enabled.

Updated design with new grille colour and logo treatment.
The updated Solo Soundbar Series 2 features a black grille for a more modern aesthetic with a fresh look and feel.

More clarity—soundbar for voice clarity
In the improved Dialogue Mode, the Bose Solo Soundbar Series 2 makes every word easier to understand without having to adjust the volume. Simply press the “Dialogue Mode” button on the included remote to enable.

Built-in Dolby® decoding
The Solo Soundbar Series 2 features built-in Dolby® decoding to create a richer, more satisfying listening experience with remarkable authenticity.

More music—Bluetooth® soundbar
The Bose Solo Soundbar Series 2 also has Bluetooth streaming, so you can listen to what you want, when you want, with Bluetooth connection to your device. Press the Bluetooth button on the included remote to pair a device and wirelessly play music, podcasts and more through your soundbar.

More bass
And while the Bose Solo Soundbar Series 2 delivers surprisingly rich and deep sound for a soundbar of its size, you can press the “BASS” button on the remote for some added depth.

Easy to set up. Easy to use.
A single connection to your TV via an optical audio cable (included) ensures easy set-up, so you can start using your Bose Solo Soundbar Series 2 right away.

Bose Solo Soundbar Series II
Power cable
Optical cable
Remote control (battery included)
Wall bracket

title: Monster 2 Socket Surge Protector (White)
body_html:
Introducing the Monster Double outlet appliances surge protector - the ultimate solution for protecting your valuable appliances from power surges and voltage spikes. With a 700 joule rating and fireproof MOV technology, this surge protector is designed to effectively absorb and redirect excess voltage away from your appliances, preventing damage and prolonging their lifespan. The LED surge indicator light lets you know that your devices are protected and gives you peace of mind. But that's not all - this surge protector also comes with a remarkable $10,000 connected equipment warranty. With this warranty, you can rest assured that your appliances are covered in case of damage due to power surges. Don't risk damaging your appliances - protect them with the Monster single outlet appliances surge protector.

Why do I need a Surge Protector
A surge protector is an electrical device designed to protect your electronic devices from power surges or voltage spikes. Power surges can occur due to lightning strikes, power outages, or fluctuations in the electrical grid. Without a surge protector, these power surges can cause damage to your electronic devices, including your computer, TV, and other appliances. A surge protector helps to absorb and redirect the excess voltage away from your devices, protecting them from damage. Additionally, surge protectors can also prevent electrical fires and increase the lifespan of your electronic devices. In summary, using a surge protector can help protect your electronic devices from power surges and increase their lifespan, ultimately saving you money in the long run.

title: Hisense 65" S7NAU Canvas 4K QLED Smart TV [2024]
body_html:
In the landscape of modern television technology, the intersection of art and functionality has given rise to innovative products that redefine the user’s living space. When Art Mode is on, Hisense Canvas TV transforms into a canvas displaying artwork* or your own photos. Customise your space with StyleSwap Frames** and enjoy Quantum Dot colour and 4K definition on an anti-glare matte display. But it’s not just about looks — Canvas TV is smart and intuitive, delivering a sharp, fluid cinematic experience.
* By signing up for a free VIDAA account and signing in to the VIDAA Art App, users can access an extensive library of over 1000 art pieces.
** A teak frame is included in the TV box, and consumers can redeem an extra frame, oak white or walnut, at no cost by registering with Hisense.

Key Features

Transform Your Wall Into a Masterpiece
Hisense Canvas TV offers an impressive selection of art content. By signing up for a free VIDAA account and signing in to the VIDAA Art App, users can access an extensive library of over 1000 art pieces, providing a rich and diverse collection to suit all tastes. Even without signing in, viewers can still enjoy 300 free art pieces, ensuring that everyone has access to beautiful and inspiring content. By turning on the Art Mode, the chosen art piece will be displayed when the TV is off, transforming your screen into a captivating gallery.

Make Art Mode your own.
Enjoy viewing your favourite photos on the bigger screen and relive those precious moments. Simply upload pictures via the VIDAA app from your mobile device.

See the Story, Not the Glare
The Hi-Matte display ensures your screen is always clear and vibrant, unaffected by ambient light. Elevate your art viewing experience with the high haze screen, where every scene mirrors the depth and texture of original paintings.

Colours in Dazzling 4K
Experience over a billion shades of vibrant colour and stunning quality with 4K Resolution and Quantum Dot Colour. Every frame transforms into a window to a breathtakingly real world, creating an image so lifelike that you’ll feel a part of the scene.

Perfect View Day or Night
With the built-in light sensor, your screen effortlessly and instantly adapts to your surroundings. Your TV now adjusts the colour temperature and brightness of your screen for a more authentic and visually pleasing experience, ensuring you get the perfect view day or night.

Find the Art in Audio
Experience the thrill of being in the heart of the action with our multi-dimensional spatial surround sound. Filling your room with immersive audio, making movies, games, and music come alive like never before.

Smooth Moves, Sharper Victories
Say goodbye to choppy visuals, blurry details and slow input from your game controller! Thanks to ALLM, VRR and MEMC, you’ll experience silky smooth frames with a 144Hz refresh rate. Dive deeper into your games with faster reactions and a truly immersive experience.

Seamless, Stunning, Space-saving
This UltraSlim Wall Mount fits your TV snugly against the wall, saving precious space and giving it a sleek, picture-like appearance. It’s also lightweight, making it easy to install and manage.
*A small gap between the wall and TV may occur if wall is not 100% flat or is constructed off-angle to the floor or if installed incorrectly.

Easy. Fast. Secure. Global and Local Entertainment.
With a faster, more customisable operating system, finding great entertainment fast has never been easier. Switch between apps and connected devices, receive recommendations and search thousands of shows across Netflix, YouTube, Prime Video, Disney+, Kayo, Foxtel, Stan iView, Freeview Plus and many more!

title: TCL 50" C7K 4K UHD QD-Mini LED Google TV [2025]
body_html:
QLED with Mini LED
TCL's QD-Mini LED combines the merits of QLED and OLED technologies, transforming the traditional backlight into lighting that is close to pixel-level precision. It also utilizes the world's leading QLED technology, offering contrast and colour gamut comparable to OLED, while also providing higher peak brightness and a longer lifespan. This represents the future technology of large-screen displays.

Mini LED TV: The Halo Eliminator
The TCL all-domain halo control technology covers the entire path from light generation to imaging, integrating high-efficiency light-emitting chips and self-developed lens technology, combined with Micro-OD, light and shadow control algorithms, and TCL's unique self-produced high-end CSOT HVA Panel technology. Through system-level precise control of light, it effectively solves the halo problem and delivers a premium viewing experience.

Enriched dark and light details, more realistic image reproduction
Combined with human perception characteristics and picture pixel information, the lighting details are optimized for SDR and HDR signals, while the details and contrast of light and dark scenes are greatly improved. Enjoy more real lighting effects of streaming media resources on TCL TV.

Smoother and clearer
From signal processing to screen display, the C7K supports 4K 144Hz ultra-high native refresh rate throughout the entire chain, effectively solving the problem of image stuttering and making moving images clearer.

It perceives, it thinks, it produces
TCL's self-developed AiPQ Pro Processor incorporates numerous TCL's unique image quality tuning algorithms. This chip has excellent intelligent sensing capabilities and can make pixel-level adjustments to the image quality, thus providing a top-notch viewing experience.

Ai Contrast
Perceive the brightness information of each image in the TV picture and combine the brightness characteristics of the viewing environment to intelligently adjust the contrast of the picture to make the bright and dark details clearer.

Ai Colour
Intelligently identify the colour characteristics of the picture and carry out dynamic colour calibration and skin tone protection, bringing more vivid colour performance, allowing users to get an immersive experience when playing games or viewing movies.

Ai HDR
The Powerful TCL Ai HDR supports almost all HDR formats such as Dolby Vision, HDR 10+, HDR10, HLG, etc. And plus, it could upscale SDR to HDR by enhancing the picture quality in movies and shows with a wider range of colours with brighter highlights.

Ai Motion
Powered by TCL AiPQ Pro Processor, MEMC detects fast-moving objects sensitively in their size and position in the image, it calculates motion in terms of frame number with up to 4K 144Hz VRR, just to restore the silky-smooth image in compensating for blurring and tearing in the exciting sports, games, and movies.

Play like a pro
Experience next-level gaming with the best elevating technology in action. Unlock advanced display and audio technology, try smoother streaming with TCL Game Master

Adaptive game screen for three major consoles
Gamebar has customized exclusive screen design for the three major mainstream gaming consoles, bringing the game vibe to the fullest. Gamebar integrates many graphics and game modes, allowing you to make personalized game settings and stack up BUFFs at the start.

No tearing. No stuttering. Just gaming
The AMD FreeSync technology promises seamless, artifact-free gameplay at almost any frame rate, putting an end to choppy gameplay and broken frames. It is regarded as the next breakthrough in PC and console gaming.

Key Features

50" 4K Full Array Quantum Dot Mini LED Technology

200 Clear Motion Rate with VRR144Hz

Auto Low Latency Mode (ALLM) & Freesync Premium Pro

Google TV operating system with Chromecast

Apple AirPlay 2/Homekit

HDR10+ & Dolby Vision IQ & Dolby Atmos

The Ultimate and Safest in Power Protection
The combination of our Fireproof Self-Tripping Metal Oxide Varistors (MOVs) with fast-acting thermal cut-outs, along with negative resistance componentry, protect your equipment from significant damage and potential fires that power issues such as surges can initiate.

body_html:
Full-motion, ultra-slim TV wall mount for high-end TVs from 32 to 65 inches
With the elegant ELITE Full-Motion+ TV wall mount, you're choosing design and performance. The wall mount is specially designed for TVs from 32 to 65 inches in size and weighing up to 35 kg, and can be turned up to 180°, allowing you to optimally enjoy your TV from any corner in the room. In the starting position, there is only 4 cm between the TV and the wall. Available in White and Platinum Grey colours.

Ultra-slim design, ultimate enjoyment
The ELITE Full-Motion+ TV wall mount is the slimmest TV wall mount in our range, yet still offers an enormous weight-bearing capacity. As such, the ELITE Full-Motion+ is the ideal TV wall mount for large high-end TVs, such as OLED and QLED TVs.

Enjoy your TV from any angle
With the ELITE Full-Motion+ TV wall mount, you can enjoy your TV from any angle. The wall mount has extra-long support arms of 56 cm. Depending on the display size, you can turn your TV up to 90° to the left and right. And thanks to OneFinger™ Movement, you can effortlessly turn your display to the desired viewing angle with just one finger. A tilt function has been omitted because it is best not to tilt large, fragile displays.

Perfection in every respect
ELITE Full-Motion+ TV wall mounts feature 2D Leveling™, which allows you to mount your TV perfectly straight, both horizontally and vertically, even after installation. And perfection also applies to the finishing touches of the wall mounts. For example, the unique Cable Inlay System (CIS®) guides the cables through the support arms, with special holders to neatly conceal the cables at the back. All technical details of the TV wall mount are nicely hidden behind stylish cover plates.

Safety first
Every ELITE Full-Motion+ TV wall mount meets the strictest safety requirements, is TUV-certified and is tested to three times its maximum weight capacity. To minimise the chance of damaging your thin, fragile display, you cannot tilt the ELITE Full-Motion+ TV wall mount.

Installation made easy
The ELITE Full-Motion+ TV wall mount is easy to install, thanks to the included Quick Install Guide with explanation. Need more help? A detailed manual is available online, plus an installation video. A spirit level, drilling template, screws and fischer® DuoPower plugs are included. Plus, the free Vogel's DrillRight™ AR app makes it easy to mark out the first drill hole. Soft patches on the wall mount protect the back of your TV during mounting.

Key Features

Smooth one finger movement

2D levelling keeps TV level at all times

Up to 180° swivel

Supports max VESA hole patterns of 400 x 400mm

Ultra slim (40mm from wall) and strong, supporting max 35kg

title: Amazon Alexa Voice Remote Pro
body_html:
A remote that helps you find everything. Even itself
Spend less time searching, more time watching. Just say, “Alexa, find my remote,” to any Amazon device with Alexa, Alexa built-in device, the Alexa app, or Fire TV app. A built-in speaker will emit a ring to lead you right to it. You can also use the Remote Finder button within the Fire TV mobile app. You can then use integrated TV controls or two customizable buttons to find and get to your entertainment quickly. The Remote Finder feature has a range of up to 10m and requires the Fire TV device to be on.

Lights up in the dark
Alexa Voice Remote Pro features backlit buttons that illuminate when you pick it up in a dimly-lit room. Now you can enjoy the action on-screen while keeping the home movie theatre atmosphere going.

Your remote. Your shortcuts.
Assign your favourite apps to two customizable buttons for quick access to your content. You can also assign many of your favourite Alexa commands so you can turn on compatible smart lights, check the weather, or view your Ring camera with one touch. Just press and hold. Then select a shortcut option from the on-screen pop-up. You can easily choose recently-used apps, Alexa commands, or smart home controls to program.

Full sound. Zero disturbance.
A dedicated headphone button gives you quick access to your on-screen Bluetooth menu where you can easily pair or unpair your favourite audio device. So, when you're relaxing with a movie, you can pair your wireless headphones with ease. Content shown may require subscription.

The all-in-one remote with TV controls
Control your compatible TV, soundbar, and receiver with dedicated power, volume, and mute buttons. You can also get to your favourite shows and movies faster with preset app shortcuts (app buttons may vary). It’s expansive control and easy navigation without juggling multiple remotes.

From remote control to smart control
Go beyond your watchlist. Just press and ask, “Alexa, dim the lights,” to get movie night going or “Alexa, show me my front door,” to view a live feed from your Ring security camera. You can also use Alexa Voice Remote Pro to check the weather, play music, and control more of your favourite smart home functions right from the couch. “Alexa, find action movies.“

Compatible with most Fire TV devices
Alexa Voice Remote Pro requires a compatible Fire TV device. This remote is not compatible with Fire TV (1st and 2nd Gen) or Fire TV Stick (1st Gen).

How to set up

Step 1: Insert batteries to power up your Alexa Voice Remote Pro.

Step 2: Pair your remote with your Fire TV device.

Step 3: Follow the on-screen instructions to program the customizable buttons

Key Features

Use a device with Alexa, the Alexa app or Fire TV app and Alexa Voice Remote Pro will emit a ring. No searching cushions

Navigate movie night with motion-activated buttons that illuminate in dimly-lit rooms

Create your own shortcuts to favourite apps, or many Alexa commands

A new shortcut to the on-screen Bluetooth menu that lets you pair your wireless headphones fast

Control your compatible TV, soundbar and receiver using dedicated power and volume buttons. Quickly access your favourite content with convenient app buttons

Use your voice to find your shows, open apps, manage volume, and even control compatible smart home devices

2 AAA batteries

title: TCL 65" C6K 4K UHD QD-Mini LED Google TV [2025]
body_html:
QLED with Mini LED
TCL's QD-Mini LED combines the merits of QLED and OLED technologies, transforming the traditional backlight into lighting that is close to pixel-level precision. It also utilizes the world's leading QLED technology, offering contrast and colour gamut comparable to OLED, while also providing higher peak brightness and a longer lifespan. This represents the future technology of large-screen displays.

Mini LED TV: The Halo Eliminator
The TCL all-domain halo control technology covers the entire path from light generation to imaging, integrating high-efficiency light-emitting chips and self-developed lens technology, combined with Micro-OD, light and shadow control algorithms, and high-end HVA Panel technology. Through system-level precise control of light, it effectively solves the halo problem and delivers a premium viewing experience.

Master light and dark, capture intricate details
Compared with the previous generation of conventional light-emitting chip, C6K's ground-breaking Powerful Light-emitting Chip significantly improves brightness and energy efficiency, reproducing natural bright and dark scenes with clarity.

Micro lens, big power
TCL's self-developed condensed micro lens technology precisely controls light direction through its arch bridge dimming design. Through the elite light type calculation model, a golden curvature with super light focusing ability is formed, which greatly improves the backlight uniformity and halo control for clearer screen details.

Enriched dark and light details, more realistic image reproduction
Combined with human perception characteristics and picture pixel information, the lighting details are optimized for SDR and HDR signals, while the details and contrast of light and dark scenes are greatly improved. Enjoy more real lighting effects of streaming media resources on TCL TV.

Bright and brilliant
Even in midsummer when the sun shines into the room, you still can see clear pictures with vivid colours. Enjoy the details hidden in the sunny or shadowy scene.

Smoother and clearer
From signal processing to screen display, the C6K supports 4K 144Hz ultra-high native refresh rate throughout the entire chain, effectively solving the problem of image stuttering and making moving images clearer.

It perceives, it thinks, it produces
TCL's self-developed AiPQ Pro Processor incorporates numerous TCL's unique image quality tuning algorithms. This chip has excellent intelligent sensing capabilities and can make pixel-level adjustments to the image quality, thus providing a top-notch viewing experience.

Ai Colour
Intelligently identify the colour characteristics of the picture and carry out dynamic colour calibration and skin tone protection, bringing more vivid colour performance, allowing users to get an immersive experience when playing games or viewing movies.

Ai HDR
The Powerful TCL Ai HDR supports almost all HDR formats such as Dolby Vision, HDR 10+, HDR10, HLG, etc. And plus, it could upscale SDR to HDR by enhancing the picture quality in movies and shows with a wider range of colours with brighter highlights.

Ai Motion
Powered by TCL AiPQ Pro Processor, MEMC detects fast-moving objects sensitively in their size and position in the image, it calculates motion in terms of frame number with up to 4K 144Hz VRR, just to restore the silky-smooth image in compensating for blurring and tearing in the exciting sports, games, and movies.

Defining the standard for home theatre
TCL C6K combines the power of ONKYO's 2.1 CH Hi-Fi. Immerse yourself in the captivating stereo sound and thunderous bass, capturing every detail as if you were at a live band performance. Elevate your home theatre experience with unparalleled audio excellence.

Huge waves, ground trembled
The C6K is equipped with independent, overweight bass units at the back. The sound structure is constructed using high-end hardware materials, delivering a powerful and immersive audio experience.

Theatrical sound enjoyment
Dolby Atmos transcends conventional channel limitations to deliver three-dimensional audio. You can experience astounding clarity, increased emotional impact, and immersive, room-filling sound.
*Dolby, Dolby Atmos and the double-D symbol are registered trademarks of Dolby Laboratories.

Play like a pro
Experience next-level gaming with the best elevating technology in action. Unlock advanced display and audio technology, try smoother streaming with TCL Game Master

Adaptive game screen for three major consoles
Gamebar has customized exclusive screen design for the three major mainstream gaming consoles, bringing the game vibe to the fullest. Gamebar integrates many graphics and game modes, allowing you to make personalized game settings and stack up BUFFs at the start.

No tearing. No stuttering. Just gaming
The AMD FreeSync technology promises seamless, artifact-free gameplay at almost any frame rate, putting an end to choppy gameplay and broken frames. It is regarded as the next breakthrough in PC and console gaming.

Key Features

65" 4K Full Array Quantum Dot Mini LED Technology

200 Clear Motion Rate with VRR144Hz

Auto Low Latency Mode (ALLM) & Freesync Premium Pro

Google TV operating system with Chromecast

Apple AirPlay 2/Homekit

2.1 Channel Onkyo Sound with built-in Subwoofer

IMAX Enhanced, HDR10+, Dolby Vision IQ & Dolby Atmos

The ELITE Full-Motion+ TV wall mount is specifically designed to do full justice to large televisions, perfect for your OLED or QLED TV. The TV wall mount is ultra-slim, ultra-strong and can be turned up to 180°, enabling you to optimally enjoy your TV from any angle. This TV wall mount is suitable for TVs from 55 to 100 inches in size and weighing up to 55 kg. Your TV is mounted just 4 cm from the wall.

Turn your TV to the ideal viewing position with just one finger
The ELITE Full-Motion+ TV wall mount features 74 cm long support arms. This makes it possible to turn your TV up to 90° to the left and right, depending on your display size. You can set your ideal viewing angle with just one finger thanks to Vogel's One-Finger™ Movement technology. Because it is best not to tilt large, fragile displays, the wall mount does not have a tilt function.

Perfectly level thanks to 2D Leveling™
Details make the difference. That is why ELITE Full-Motion+ TV wall mounts are equipped with 2D Leveling™. This is particularly useful for large displays. It makes it easy to adjust your TV so that it is perfectly level, both horizontally and vertically. Even after installation.

Cables? They're there, but you don't see them.
The ELITE Full-Motion+ TV wall mount has smart solutions to conceal your cables. For example, the unique Cable Inlay System (CIS®) guides the cables through the support arms. And you can neatly conceal the cables at the back of your TV using the special cable holders on the wall mount. All of the wall mount's technical details and cables are nicely hidden behind cover plates.

Completely safe
ELITE Full-Motion+ TV wall mounts meet the most stringent safety requirements. The TV wall mount is TüV certified and tested to three times its maximum weight capacity. So, your TV is perfectly safe.

Easy to install
Installing the ELITE Full-Motion+ TV wall mount is easy. A Quick Install Guide with clear explanations is included. You can also find a detailed manual and special installation video online. A spirit level, drilling template, screws and fischer® DuoPower plugs are also included. With our free DrillRight™ AR app, you can easily mark the first drill hole. Soft patches on the wall mount prevent you from scratching the back of your TV during mounting.

Key Features

Smooth one finger movement

2D levelling keeps TV level at all times

Up to 180° swivel

Ultra slim (40mm from wall) and strong, supporting max 55kg

Supports max VESA hole patterns of 600 x 400mm

It’s showtime. The all-in-one JBL Bar 300 turns your movies and TV shows into a true experience and lifts your games to the next level. MultiBeam™ and Dolby Atmos® technologies deliver vivid 3D surround sound. While PureVoice technology optimizes voice clarity to ensure you never miss a word. Dolby Atmos® and MultiBeam™ Surround Sound
Immerse yourself in theater-quality 3D surround sound. Hear extraordinary sound effects from everywhere in the room, without the need for extra surround speakers.

Built-In Wi-Fi with AirPlay, Alexa Multi-Room Music and Chromecast built-in™
Get ready to explore. Access over 300 online music streaming services through AirPlay, Alexa MRM and Chromecast built-in™. Enjoy all of your favourite audio content, Internet radio, and podcasts in high definition. The Wi-Fi connection also allows automatic software updates, so you can always enjoy the latest features.

260W output power

Punchy bass without a separate subwoofer
Don’t let the compact size of the JBL Bar 300 fool you. It gives your home cinematic experience a boost of punchy bass from its built-in bass port, adding more excitement to every action scene and more depth to every song.

PureVoice dialogue enhancement technology

HDMI eARC with 4K Dolby Vision passthrough

Easy sound calibration
Every room is different. Our audio calibration feature ensures that the JBL Bar 300 delivers the best 3D surround effects for any interior and room layout.

JBL One App

Intelligent processing upscales ordinary stereo sound to extraordinary 3D surround.
Be immersed. Our 3D Surround Upscaling creates virtual surround from above and the sides using just the TV speakers. Even 2ch and 5.1ch audio is upscaled to immersive 5.1.2ch sound. Moreover, Dolby Atmos® and DTS:X® support provides unforgettable spatial sound.

title: TCL 85" C6K 4K UHD QD-Mini LED Google TV [2025]
body_html:
QLED with Mini LED
TCL's QD-Mini LED combines the merits of QLED and OLED technologies, transforming the traditional backlight into lighting that is close to pixel-level precision. It also utilizes the world's leading QLED technology, offering contrast and colour gamut comparable to OLED, while also providing higher peak brightness and a longer lifespan. This represents the future technology of large-screen displays.

Mini LED TV: The Halo Eliminator
The TCL all-domain halo control technology covers the entire path from light generation to imaging, integrating high-efficiency light-emitting chips and self-developed lens technology, combined with Micro-OD, light and shadow control algorithms, and high-end HVA Panel technology. Through system-level precise control of light, it effectively solves the halo problem and delivers a premium viewing experience.

Master light and dark, capture intricate details
Compared with the previous generation of conventional light-emitting chip, C6K's ground-breaking Powerful Light-emitting Chip significantly improves brightness and energy efficiency, reproducing natural bright and dark scenes with clarity.

Micro lens, big power
TCL's self-developed condensed micro lens technology precisely controls light direction through its arch bridge dimming design. Through the elite light type calculation model, a golden curvature with super light focusing ability is formed, which greatly improves the backlight uniformity and halo control for clearer screen details.

Enriched dark and light details, more realistic image reproduction
Combined with human perception characteristics and picture pixel information, the lighting details are optimized for SDR and HDR signals, while the details and contrast of light and dark scenes are greatly improved. Enjoy more real lighting effects of streaming media resources on TCL TV.

Bright and brilliant
Even in midsummer when the sun shines into the room, you still can see clear pictures with vivid colours. Enjoy the details hidden in the sunny or shadowy scene.

Smoother and clearer
From signal processing to screen display, the C6K supports 4K 144Hz ultra-high native refresh rate throughout the entire chain, effectively solving the problem of image stuttering and making moving images clearer.

It perceives, it thinks, it produces
TCL's self-developed AiPQ Pro Processor incorporates numerous TCL's unique image quality tuning algorithms. This chip has excellent intelligent sensing capabilities and can make pixel-level adjustments to the image quality, thus providing a top-notch viewing experience.

Ai Colour
Intelligently identify the colour characteristics of the picture and carry out dynamic colour calibration and skin tone protection, bringing more vivid colour performance, allowing users to get an immersive experience when playing games or viewing movies.

Ai HDR
The Powerful TCL Ai HDR supports almost all HDR formats such as Dolby Vision, HDR 10+, HDR10, HLG, etc. And plus, it could upscale SDR to HDR by enhancing the picture quality in movies and shows with a wider range of colours with brighter highlights.

Ai Motion
Powered by TCL AiPQ Pro Processor, MEMC detects fast-moving objects sensitively in their size and position in the image, it calculates motion in terms of frame number with up to 4K 144Hz VRR, just to restore the silky-smooth image in compensating for blurring and tearing in the exciting sports, games, and movies.

Defining the standard for home theatre
TCL C6K combines the power of ONKYO's 2.1 CH Hi-Fi. Immerse yourself in the captivating stereo sound and thunderous bass, capturing every detail as if you were at a live band performance. Elevate your home theatre experience with unparalleled audio excellence.

Huge waves, ground trembled
The C6K is equipped with independent, overweight bass units at the back. The sound structure is constructed using high-end hardware materials, delivering a powerful and immersive audio experience.

Theatrical sound enjoyment
Dolby Atmos transcends conventional channel limitations to deliver three-dimensional audio. You can experience astounding clarity, increased emotional impact, and immersive, room-filling sound.
*Dolby, Dolby Atmos and the double-D symbol are registered trademarks of Dolby Laboratories.

Play like a pro
Experience next-level gaming with the best elevating technology in action. Unlock advanced display and audio technology, try smoother streaming with TCL Game Master

Adaptive game screen for three major consoles
Gamebar has customized exclusive screen design for the three major mainstream gaming consoles, bringing the game vibe to the fullest. Gamebar integrates many graphics and game modes, allowing you to make personalized game settings and stack up BUFFs at the start.

No tearing. No stuttering. Just gaming
The AMD FreeSync technology promises seamless, artifact-free gameplay at almost any frame rate, putting an end to choppy gameplay and broken frames. It is regarded as the next breakthrough in PC and console gaming.

Key Features

85" 4K Full Array Quantum Dot Mini LED Technology

200 Clear Motion Rate with VRR144Hz

Auto Low Latency Mode (ALLM) & Freesync Premium Pro

Google TV operating system with Chromecast

Apple AirPlay 2/Homekit

2.1 Channel Onkyo Sound with built-in Subwoofer

IMAX Enhanced, HDR10+, Dolby Vision IQ & Dolby Atmos

TCL's QD-Mini LED combines the merits of QLED and OLED technologies, transforming the traditional backlight into lighting that is close to pixel-level precision. It also utilizes the world's leading QLED technology, offering contrast and colour gamut comparable to OLED, while also providing higher peak brightness and a longer lifespan. This represents the future technology of large-screen displays.

Mini LED TV: The Halo Eliminator
The TCL all-domain halo control technology covers the entire path from light generation to imaging, integrating high-efficiency light-emitting chips and self-developed lens technology, combined with Micro-OD, light and shadow control algorithms, and high-end HVA Panel technology. Through system-level precise control of light, it effectively solves the halo problem and delivers a premium viewing experience.

Master light and dark, capture intricate details
Compared with the previous generation of conventional light-emitting chip, C6K's ground-breaking Powerful Light-emitting Chip significantly improves brightness and energy efficiency, reproducing natural bright and dark scenes with clarity.

Micro lens, big power
TCL's self-developed condensed micro lens technology precisely controls light direction through its arch bridge dimming design. Through the elite light type calculation model, a golden curvature with super light focusing ability is formed, which greatly improves the backlight uniformity and halo control for clearer screen details.

Enriched dark and light details, more realistic image reproduction
Combined with human perception characteristics and picture pixel information, the lighting details are optimized for SDR and HDR signals, while the details and contrast of light and dark scenes are greatly improved. Enjoy more real lighting effects of streaming media resources on TCL TV.

Bright and brilliant
Even in midsummer when the sun shines into the room, you still can see clear pictures with vivid colours. Enjoy the details hidden in the sunny or shadowy scene.

Smoother and clearer
From signal processing to screen display, the C6K supports 4K 144Hz ultra-high native refresh rate throughout the entire chain, effectively solving the problem of image stuttering and making moving images clearer.

It perceives, it thinks, it produces
TCL's self-developed AiPQ Pro Processor incorporates numerous TCL's unique image quality tuning algorithms. This chip has excellent intelligent sensing capabilities and can make pixel-level adjustments to the image quality, thus providing a top-notch viewing experience.

Ai Colour
Intelligently identify the colour characteristics of the picture and carry out dynamic colour calibration and skin tone protection, bringing more vivid colour performance, allowing users to get an immersive experience when playing games or viewing movies.

Ai HDR
The Powerful TCL Ai HDR supports almost all HDR formats such as Dolby Vision, HDR 10+, HDR10, HLG, etc. And plus, it could upscale SDR to HDR by enhancing the picture quality in movies and shows with a wider range of colours with brighter highlights.

Ai Motion
Powered by TCL AiPQ Pro Processor, MEMC detects fast-moving objects sensitively in their size and position in the image, it calculates motion in terms of frame number with up to 4K 144Hz VRR, just to restore the silky-smooth image in compensating for blurring and tearing in the exciting sports, games, and movies.

Defining the standard for home theatre
TCL C6K combines the power of ONKYO's 2.1 CH Hi-Fi. Immerse yourself in the captivating stereo sound and thunderous bass, capturing every detail as if you were at a live band performance. Elevate your home theatre experience with unparalleled audio excellence.

Huge waves, ground trembled
The C6K is equipped with independent, overweight bass units at the back. The sound structure is constructed using high-end hardware materials, delivering a powerful and immersive audio experience.

Theatrical sound enjoyment
Dolby Atmos transcends conventional channel limitations to deliver three-dimensional audio. You can experience astounding clarity, increased emotional impact, and immersive, room-filling sound.
*Dolby, Dolby Atmos and the double-D symbol are registered trademarks of Dolby Laboratories.

Play like a pro
Experience next-level gaming with the best elevating technology in action. Unlock advanced display and audio technology, try smoother streaming with TCL Game Master

Adaptive game screen for three major consoles
Gamebar has customized exclusive screen design for the three major mainstream gaming consoles, bringing the game vibe to the fullest. Gamebar integrates many graphics and game modes, allowing you to make personalized game settings and stack up BUFFs at the start.

No tearing. No stuttering. Just gaming
The AMD FreeSync technology promises seamless, artifact-free gameplay at almost any frame rate, putting an end to choppy gameplay and broken frames. It is regarded as the next breakthrough in PC and console gaming.

Key Features

75" 4K Full Array Quantum Dot Mini LED Technology

200 Clear Motion Rate with VRR144Hz

Auto Low Latency Mode (ALLM) & Freesync Premium Pro

Google TV operating system with Chromecast

Apple AirPlay 2/Homekit

2.1 Channel Onkyo Sound with built-in Subwoofer

IMAX Enhanced, HDR10+, Dolby Vision IQ & Dolby Atmos

title: TCL 65" C7K 4K UHD QD-Mini LED Google TV [2025]
body_html:
QLED with Mini LED
TCL's QD-Mini LED combines the merits of QLED and OLED technologies, transforming the traditional backlight into lighting that is close to pixel-level precision. It also utilizes the world's leading QLED technology, offering contrast and colour gamut comparable to OLED, while also providing higher peak brightness and a longer lifespan. This represents the future technology of large-screen displays.

Mini LED TV: The Halo Eliminator
The TCL all-domain halo control technology covers the entire path from light generation to imaging, integrating high-efficiency light-emitting chips and self-developed lens technology, combined with Micro-OD, light and shadow control algorithms, and TCL's unique self-produced high-end CSOT HVA Panel technology. Through system-level precise control of light, it effectively solves the halo problem and delivers a premium viewing experience.

Enriched dark and light details, more realistic image reproduction
Combined with human perception characteristics and picture pixel information, the lighting details are optimized for SDR and HDR signals, while the details and contrast of light and dark scenes are greatly improved. Enjoy more real lighting effects of streaming media resources on TCL TV.

Smoother and clearer
From signal processing to screen display, the C7K supports 4K 144Hz ultra-high native refresh rate throughout the entire chain, effectively solving the problem of image stuttering and making moving images clearer.

It perceives, it thinks, it produces
TCL's self-developed AiPQ Pro Processor incorporates numerous TCL's unique image quality tuning algorithms. This chip has excellent intelligent sensing capabilities and can make pixel-level adjustments to the image quality, thus providing a top-notch viewing experience.

Ai Contrast
Perceive the brightness information of each image in the TV picture and combine the brightness characteristics of the viewing environment to intelligently adjust the contrast of the picture to make the bright and dark details clearer.

Ai Colour
Intelligently identify the colour characteristics of the picture and carry out dynamic colour calibration and skin tone protection, bringing more vivid colour performance, allowing users to get an immersive experience when playing games or viewing movies.

Ai HDR
The Powerful TCL Ai HDR supports almost all HDR formats such as Dolby Vision, HDR 10+, HDR10, HLG, etc. And plus, it could upscale SDR to HDR by enhancing the picture quality in movies and shows with a wider range of colours with brighter highlights.

Ai Motion
Powered by TCL AiPQ Pro Processor, MEMC detects fast-moving objects sensitively in their size and position in the image, it calculates motion in terms of frame number with up to 4K 144Hz VRR, just to restore the silky-smooth image in compensating for blurring and tearing in the exciting sports, games, and movies.

The mark of elevated audio
Since 1925, Bang & Olufsen has given the world audio that defies conventions and surpasses expectations. Now you can experience this exceptional sound quality in your TCL television, through Audio by Bang & Olufsen. This mark of great sound means that the speakers in your TV have been worked on by the same engineers who design, tune and refine Bang & Olufsen’s iconic speakers. They pour in a century of expertise, so that only the purest sound comes out.

Play like a pro
Experience next-level gaming with the best elevating technology in action. Unlock advanced display and audio technology, try smoother streaming with TCL Game Master

Adaptive game screen for three major consoles
Gamebar has customized exclusive screen design for the three major mainstream gaming consoles, bringing the game vibe to the fullest. Gamebar integrates many graphics and game modes, allowing you to make personalized game settings and stack up BUFFs at the start.

No tearing. No stuttering. Just gaming
The AMD FreeSync technology promises seamless, artifact-free gameplay at almost any frame rate, putting an end to choppy gameplay and broken frames. It is regarded as the next breakthrough in PC and console gaming.

Key Features

65" 4K Full Array Quantum Dot Mini LED Technology

200 Clear Motion Rate with VRR144Hz

Auto Low Latency Mode (ALLM) & Freesync Premium Pro

Google TV operating system with Chromecast

Apple AirPlay 2/Homekit

Audio by B&O, with Dolby Vision IQ & Dolby Atmos

Powered by 128 AI neural networks, this AI processor enhances your picture and sound to superb heights. Enjoy the best 4K TV experience, whether you're watching streaming services, playing your favourite video games, or watching live sports.1

Our 4K AI Upscaling Pro technology powered by 128 AI neural networks transforms content into a 4K resolution. Our NQ4 AI Gen3 Processor enables sharp and smooth picture quality.2

OLED HDR+
Enjoy HDR10+ content on your OLED screen. With extraordinary detail in both dark and light scenes, you can experience lifelike colour and deep contrast.3

Level up your gaming experience with exceptional motion enhancements up to 144Hz VRR. Providing crisp visuals at high speeds, unlock peak performance in every round. HDMI 2.1 compatibility provides access to ultra-high bandwidth for compatible devices, helping you keep ahead of the competition.4

Faster, smoother low input lag gameplay
Auto Low Latency Mode sets optimal latency settings for your games automatically, allowing for smooth gaming and fast reactions to your commands.6

Tear free, stutter free, low latency HDR gaming
Built on AMD FreeSync™ core technology to reduce stutter and screen tearing, FreeSync Premium Pro provides a true HDR gaming experience. It produces exceptional high dynamic range visuals while maintaining low latency for effortlessly smooth gameplay.7

A next level Dolby Atmos experience
Enjoy a next-level surround sound experience that immerses you deep inside the action. With Dolby Atmos, it delivers multi-dimensional audio for unbelievably realistic sound.

3D surround sound with our virtual top channel audio allows you to be immersed in the audio experience.

Enjoy clear dialogue, no matter what's going on. Our AI technology enhances voice clarity by analysing ambient noise and background sounds from your content.

title: Hisense 75" Q6NAU 4K QLED Smart TV [2024]
body_html:
The Q6NAU is packed with great features like Quantum Dot Colour for pure colours with stunning gradients, a 4K AI upscaler that works to upgrade your content to near-4k quality and Dolby Vision for an authentic movie experience with cinema’s leading technologies. The Series Q6NAU is sure to impress!

Key Features

Mastering perfection
With 4K content becoming increasingly more common, make sure you can watch your favourite movies, TV shows, and more the way they were meant to be seen, full of incredible depth and richness. Even with lower quality video, the Al upscaler analyses each frame, adjusting the pixels to produce the best 4k image possible, so even older content is brought to life before your eyes.

Billion+ shades of vivid colour
Quantum Dot TVs boast one of the most efficient technologies for bright, precise colour. By using quantum dots to emit extremely precise wavelengths of light, Quantum Dot Colour creates the possibility of witnessing billions of new shades at incredibly impressive levels of brightness. This all results in a significant colour volume for an array of colours that borders on the impossible.

Unlock smooth gameplay
Game Mode PLUS is your ticket to fluid, immersive gameplay. Boasting a 60Hz panel with variable refresh rate and low latency MEMC, it bridges the gap between graphics card and display. Say goodbye to lag and hello to a game that flows as smoothly as your skills.

See the contents dazzling details
Hisense TVs have taken the only sensible approach to HDR with support for all major formats, including Dolby Vision and HDR10+ Decoding. Never worry about subpar video quality or compatibility again. Simply choose and play whatever content you want, knowing you’re experiencing it in perfect detail, enhanced colours, and deeper blacks, thanks to the wide range of HDR formats.

Step into sound
Dolby Atmos® brings the missing layer of depth to TV audio, typically reserved for theatres. Leveraging technologies trusted by directors and sound mixers, this feature crafts a multi-dimensional sound environment right in your living room. Immerse yourself in spectacular entertainment with unmatched sound clarity and depth, all without extra equipment.

Al Sports Mode enables the best picture and audio quality for the smoothest viewing experience. See every crack in the field, the players determined stare, the excitement of everyone in the audience, and hear every note of the commentator’s voice. Hisense TVs intuitively sense and clean up and enhance fast-moving objects, for a perfectly fluid viewing experience.

The action, unblurred
Leverage MEMC and 3D Noise Reduction on a responsive 60Hz panel with Hisense’s Smooth Motion. This feature banishes those irritating blurs, as every intricate movement, every sudden twist, is displayed with crisp clarity, making dynamic scenes feel fluid and lifelike. Immerse yourself in unblemished action and savour every moment.

Al real-time scenario-specific optimisation
Let your TV do the work with the intelligent Al Picture optimisation software. Like the world’s greatest art critic, your TV will analyse the composition of each frame and adjust your brightness, resolution, colour settings, and more so that each scene looks perfect – and you don’t have to do anything but sit back, relax, and let your smart TV take care of everything.

Your voice, your command
The Hisense Voice Remote provides an alternative approach to interacting with your entertainment setup. With a high-quality built-in microphone, you can use the power of your voice to command your TV with the touch of a button. Pause, play, stop, rewind, fast forward, navigate between content, interact with your favourite virtual assistants, and more with one simple device.

Command your castle
Hisense TV works with Google Home to easily set up, control, and automate your connected devices, from almost anywhere. With Apple AirPlay, you can stream movies, music, games, and photos to your television right from your iPhone, iPad, or Mac. And because your television is compatible with Apple Home, you can control it on your iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, HomePod mini, or Mac using Apple Homekit technology.

Watch your movies and TV shows the way the filmmakers intended
Experience the message as it was intended with the Hisense Filmmaker Mode. Adjust your video to its original settings, to see details like the sound, aspect ratio, colour, frame rate, and more as it was originally envisioned for the most authentic display of your favourite filmmaker’s masterpiece, before it was altered for generic viewing.

Easy. Fast. Secure. Global and Local Entertainment.
With a faster, more customisable operating system, finding great entertainment fast has never been easier. Switch between apps and connected devices, receive recommendations and search thousands of shows across Netflix, YouTube, Prime Video, Disney+, Kayo, Foxtel, Stan iView, Freeview Plus and many more!

title: TCL 85" C7K 4K UHD QD-Mini LED Google TV [2025]
body_html:
QLED with Mini LED
TCL's QD-Mini LED combines the merits of QLED and OLED technologies, transforming the traditional backlight into lighting that is close to pixel-level precision. It also utilizes the world's leading QLED technology, offering contrast and colour gamut comparable to OLED, while also providing higher peak brightness and a longer lifespan. This represents the future technology of large-screen displays.

Mini LED TV: The Halo Eliminator
The TCL all-domain halo control technology covers the entire path from light generation to imaging, integrating high-efficiency light-emitting chips and self-developed lens technology, combined with Micro-OD, light and shadow control algorithms, and TCL's unique self-produced high-end CSOT HVA Panel technology. Through system-level precise control of light, it effectively solves the halo problem and delivers a premium viewing experience.

Enriched dark and light details, more realistic image reproduction
Combined with human perception characteristics and picture pixel information, the lighting details are optimized for SDR and HDR signals, while the details and contrast of light and dark scenes are greatly improved. Enjoy more real lighting effects of streaming media resources on TCL TV.

Smoother and clearer
From signal processing to screen display, the C7K supports 4K 144Hz ultra-high native refresh rate throughout the entire chain, effectively solving the problem of image stuttering and making moving images clearer.

It perceives, it thinks, it produces
TCL's self-developed AiPQ Pro Processor incorporates numerous TCL's unique image quality tuning algorithms. This chip has excellent intelligent sensing capabilities and can make pixel-level adjustments to the image quality, thus providing a top-notch viewing experience.

Ai Contrast
Perceive the brightness information of each image in the TV picture and combine the brightness characteristics of the viewing environment to intelligently adjust the contrast of the picture to make the bright and dark details clearer.

Ai Colour
Intelligently identify the colour characteristics of the picture and carry out dynamic colour calibration and skin tone protection, bringing more vivid colour performance, allowing users to get an immersive experience when playing games or viewing movies.

Ai HDR
The Powerful TCL Ai HDR supports almost all HDR formats such as Dolby Vision, HDR 10+, HDR10, HLG, etc. And plus, it could upscale SDR to HDR by enhancing the picture quality in movies and shows with a wider range of colours with brighter highlights.

Ai Motion
Powered by TCL AiPQ Pro Processor, MEMC detects fast-moving objects sensitively in their size and position in the image, it calculates motion in terms of frame number with up to 4K 144Hz VRR, just to restore the silky-smooth image in compensating for blurring and tearing in the exciting sports, games, and movies.

The mark of elevated audio
Since 1925, Bang & Olufsen has given the world audio that defies conventions and surpasses expectations. Now you can experience this exceptional sound quality in your TCL television, through Audio by Bang & Olufsen. This mark of great sound means that the speakers in your TV have been worked on by the same engineers who design, tune and refine Bang & Olufsen’s iconic speakers. They pour in a century of expertise, so that only the purest sound comes out.

Play like a pro
Experience next-level gaming with the best elevating technology in action. Unlock advanced display and audio technology, try smoother streaming with TCL Game Master

Adaptive game screen for three major consoles
Gamebar has customized exclusive screen design for the three major mainstream gaming consoles, bringing the game vibe to the fullest. Gamebar integrates many graphics and game modes, allowing you to make personalized game settings and stack up BUFFs at the start.

No tearing. No stuttering. Just gaming
The AMD FreeSync technology promises seamless, artifact-free gameplay at almost any frame rate, putting an end to choppy gameplay and broken frames. It is regarded as the next breakthrough in PC and console gaming.

Key Features

85" 4K Full Array Quantum Dot Mini LED Technology

200 Clear Motion Rate with VRR144Hz

Auto Low Latency Mode (ALLM) & Freesync Premium Pro

Google TV operating system with Chromecast

Apple AirPlay 2/Homekit

Audio by B&O, with Dolby Vision IQ & Dolby Atmos
