title: Vogel's TVM 5645 40-77" ELITE Full Motion+ TV Wall Mount (White)
body_html:
Full-motion, ultra-slim TV wall mount for high-end TVs from 40 to 77 inches
The ELITE Full-Motion+ TV wall mount combines minimalistic design with great performance. The wall mount is not only ultra-slim, but also ultra-strong and can be turned up to 180°. In short, the ultimate wall mount for large high-end TVs, such as OLED and QLED TVs. The TV wall mount is suitable for displays from 40 to 77 inches in size and weighing up to 45 kg. In the starting position, your TV is mounted just 4 cm from the wall. Available in the colours White and Platinum Grey.

Watch TV comfortably from any angle
The ELITE Full-Motion+ TV wall mount has extra long support arms of 65 cm. This makes it possible to turn your TV up to 90° to the left and right, depending on your display size, enabling you to enjoy your TV optimally from any corner in the room. Turning your TV is extremely smooth, thanks to OneFinger™ Movement, you can move the display to the desired viewing angle with just one finger. Because it's best not to tilt thin, fragile displays, the tilt function has been omitted.

Refined perfection
ELITE Full-Motion+ TV wall mounts excel in perfection. The TV wall mount features 2D Leveling™, making it easy to mount your TV perfectly straight, both horizontally and vertically, even after installation. The cables run – out of sight – through the support arms thanks to the unique Cable Inlay System (CIS®). You can neatly conceal the cables at the back of your TV using the special cable holders. All technical details of the TV wall mount are nicely hidden behind elegant cover plates.

Safety guaranteed
ELITE Full-Motion+ TV wall mounts meet the most stringent safety requirements. Each TV wall mount is TüV certified and tested to three times its maximum weight capacity.

Easy to install
The ELITE Full-Motion+ TV wall mount is easy to install. It comes with a Quick Install Guide, which explains everything clearly. You'll find even more help online, including a detailed manual and the installation video. A spirit level, drilling template, screws and fischer® DuoPower plugs are included. With our free DrillRight™ AR app, you can easily mark the first drill hole. To protect the back of your TV during mounting, soft wall mount patches are included.

Key Features

Smooth one finger movement

2D levelling keeps TV level at all times

Up to 180° swivel

Ultra slim (40mm from wall) and strong, supporting max 45kg

Supports max VESA hole patterns of 600 x 400mm

title: Belkin Connect 8-Outlet Surge Protector with Dual USB-C 30W
body_html:
Protect the life of your electronics and appliances with 900 joules of surge protection from 2M, 6 AC outlets and two fast charging USB-C PD ports. This product is rigorously tested for quality and features a Belkin 11-point safety system and best-in-class $70,000 Connected Equipment Warranty* for added peace of mind.

Key Features

900 joules of surge protection.
Reduce the risk of damage and increase the lifespan of your electronics and appliances with industry-leading protection. Our surge protector absorbs 900 joules of energy to keep your home safe from power spikes.

Dual USB-C ports.
Two USB-C ports provide you with convenient expansion and flexibility for when you’re missing a power brick. You’ll have up to 30W of power shared across the two ports to fast charge smartphones and many other devices.

Power Delivery and dynamic PPS technology.
The USB-C ports offer Power Delivery charging to compatible devices, so you’ll charge faster than using standard USB-A ports. Onboard PPS (Programmable Power Supply) technology detects the connected device and negotiates the optimal amount of power needed for an ideal fast charge.

2m power cord and built-in wall mounts.
The 2m power cord allows for easy placement under a desk or behind appliances. Plus, built-in mounting holes give you the flexibility to hang, mount, or attach your surge protector where you need it.

Protected by an 11-point safety system.
Your device is plugged into a protector that offers overvoltage, over-temperature, overload, over-current, short-circuit and clamping voltage defence. It offers 3-line AC protection (ground, neutral, and line) and is made from material that passes a Glow Wire Test at 850℃. An indicator light shows when surge protection is active, and a warning light shows when the power coming through is not grounded.

Know you’re protected at a glance.
Built-in indicator light shows you that your protection is active and working, and lets you know if it’s time to change your surge protector. A recessed power switch offers security against accidental shut off.

Stay protected with our best-in-class Connected Equipment Warranty.
Use your electronics with confidence, supported by our best-in-class warranty.

*Belkin will repair or replace electronic devices damaged by an electrical charge while properly connected to this charger, up to $70,000AU. Visit belkin.com/cew for details.

Important: Be sure to regularly check the light on your surge protector. If the light is not on, the surge protector may have absorbed excess voltage from an event such as a thunderstorm or power outage. It may no longer be protecting equipment that is connected to it, and you should immediately replace it with a new surge protector. If you use the surge protector when the light is not on, your warranty will be invalidated. In any case, we recommend replacing a surge protector after three years of use, even if the light continues to come on.

title: Vogel's DesignMount Forward Motion TV Wall Mount (40 - 77")
body_html:
Full-motion TV wall mount with unmatched design
With the DesignMount TV wall mount from the SIGNATURE series, you bring an absolute design statement into your home. The TV wall mount is in a class of its own when it comes to design, quality and experience. The stylish, minimalistic design blends seamlessly with the latest generation of large, slim TVs, such as OLED and QLED TVs. The TV wall mount is suitable for screens from 40 to 77 inches in size and with a maximum weight of 35 kg. You can turn it up to 120° for maximum viewing pleasure.

Superior design, unprecedented perfection
The Vogel's SIGNATURE DesignMount TVM 7655 TV wall mount is one of the top models in our range. The wall mount is synonymous with unprecedented perfection and is the result of almost 50 years of experience in design, craftsmanship and innovation. Do you really want the best of the best for your large high-end TV? If so, this is the TV wall mount of your dreams.

Comfortable TV viewing from any angle
Thanks to Vogel's renowned OneFinger™ Movement, you can smoothly move the TV to the desired position for optimal viewing comfort. Depending on the screen size, you can turn your TV up to 60° to the left or right. The (SPS ®) - Screen Protection System prevents your TV from hitting the wall (guaranteed for TVs up to 65 inches).

Large forward movement range
The SIGNATURE DesignMount TV wall mount has an ingenious 4-arm mechanism, with long, strong support arms. This gives the TV wall mount a large forward movement range and allows you to move your TV forward as much as 72 cm. Ideal for mounting in a cabinet or alcove.

Your cables and connections neatly out of sight
If you're going for a clean and minimalistic design, you don't want any cables in sight. That's why the TVM 7655 TV wall mount is equipped with the Cable Inlay System (CIS®). This system routes the cables through the support arms from the wall to your TV. You can also neatly conceal almost 4 metres of cable at the back of your TV thanks to the integrated cable holders with cover plate. Making your cables disappear into the wall is easy through a slot in the TV wall mount's wall plate.

Always perfectly level thanks to 3D-Leveling™
Thanks to 3D-Leveling™, you can easily level your TV horizontally, vertically and in depth after installation. Even an uneven wall presents no obstacle.

Ultimate safety
SIGNATURE series TV wall mounts are TÜV certified and therefore meet the most stringent safety requirements. The wall mounts are tested up to three times their maximum weight capacity. So, your precious TV is mounted incredibly securely on the wall. In addition, we always test wall mounts for longevity and endurance.

Easy self-installation
The SIGNATURE DesignMount TV wall mount is easy to install. Simply follow the steps in the enclosed Quick Install Guide. Or consult the detailed manual and installation video online. A drilling template, screws, and Fischer® DuoPower plugs are included. Vogel's free DrillRight™ AR App makes it easy to mark out your first drill hole. And after installation, you can easily level your TV.

Key Features

Full-Motion with 120° swivel and 7.7cm to 71.5cm of reach

Suitable for large TVs up to 77" with a 35kg max weight and up to 600mm x 400mm VESA

Smooth OneFinger™ Movement

3D-Leveling™ adjustments from the wall plate to the TV

Fully integrated Cable Inlay System (CIS®) - Connect, protect, and hide your cables from wall to TV

title: Bose Smart Soundbar (Black)
body_html:
When film, TV and music are your passion, you don’t want to just watch. That’s why there’s the Bose Smart Soundbar with shockingly immersive sound for its size. Dolby Atmos®, proprietary TrueSpace technology, and upward-firing transducers work together to intelligently analyse and separate instruments, dialogue, and effects, then place them throughout the room. Even overhead. It’s a captivating sound experience that goes beyond simply watching. AI Dialogue Mode automatically balances voice and surround sound for ultra-crisp vocal clarity.

Key Features

Total immersion. For everything you play.
When film, TV and music are your passion, you don’t want to just watch. That’s why there’s the Bose Smart Soundbar with shockingly immersive sound for its size. Featuring Dolby Atmos® and proprietary TrueSpace technology, the latest Bose soundbar has the power to make you feel everything you watch. So you get a captivating sound experience for all your entertainment – from trendy docuseries to your latest binge obsession to the summer’s streaming blockbuster.

Ultra-crisp dialogue clarity.
Having a hard time hearing what your favourite characters are saying? AI Dialogue Mode balances voice and surround sound for ultra-crisp vocal clarity. Watching an action movie? AI Dialogue Mode enhances the clarity of conversations while ensuring the roaring engines don’t drown out what’s important.

Only TrueSpace elevates it all.
Dolby Atmos® is great for elevating the sound experience of certain films and TV. But most content isn’t Atmos-encoded. For full immersion all the time, there’s Bose TrueSpace technology. No matter what you’re watching, TrueSpace intelligently analyses signals other than Dolby Atmos®, like stereo or 5.1, and upmixes them to create an immersive multi-channel sound experience. Instruments, dialogue and effects are separated and then placed around the room.

Big-time tech for a small soundbar.
It wouldn’t be a Bose smart soundbar if it weren’t packed full of technology. The acoustic architecture of Smart Soundbar squeezes five transducers – including two that fire upwards – into its compact frame. They all work together to spread sound around your room: horizontally left, right, and forwards, but most importantly above to reflect off the ceiling.

Streaming. Any way you want.
If you can get it on your phone, you can hear it through the Bose Smart Soundbar. And no matter what you stream, it all sounds deep and rich. Connect to Wi-Fi® to access integrated music services and internet radio stations through the Bose app. Or stream songs and video with Bluetooth®, Apple AirPlay 2, Spotify® Connect, or Chromecast built-in. It’s your entertainment – you choose how you stream it.

Personal Surround Sound. Cinematic immersion.
Now you can pair the Bose Ultra Open Earbuds (sold separately) with your soundbar to add new dimension to your films and TV. Acting as rear surround speakers for the individual user, they combine a unique open-ear design with breakthrough Bose Immersive Audio to add another rich layer to the sonic experience your soundbar delivers. And because it’s from Bose, you’ll enjoy the deep, rich (and in this case, personal) sound you need to feel the onscreen action.

Complete control with voice, remote or app.
For voice control, Amazon Alexa capabilities are built-in, so all you have to do is say the word. Plus, proprietary Voice4Video technology expands your Alexa voice capabilities like only a Bose soundbar can. In addition to your Bose smart soundbar, you can control your TV and cable/satellite box with just your voice. Or use your Smart Soundbar with a compatible Google device to access Works With Google Assistant features. There’s also a remote included and the Bose app, which gives you quick access to your music.

Private – or party – listening.
If ‘smart’ doesn’t exactly describe your home, you can still connect Smart Soundbar with compatible Bose Bluetooth speakers and headphones with Bose SimpleSync.* Want to watch TV but not disturb others? Pair your soundbar with select Bose headphones for a personal TV listening experience. Or do you want to add even more sound? Pair your soundbar with selected Bose Bluetooth speakers.
*For a list of products that support SimpleSync, visit: bose.com/en_us/support/article/using-groups.html

Bose SimpleSync
Pairing your Bose Smart Soundbar to compatible Bose products is now easier than ever with updated SimpleSync technology. Away from your phone? No app, no problem. Press and hold the Bluetooth® button on each device to group and sync their sound for audio that follows you from room to room. You can now also connect your Bose Smart Soundbar to a pre-existing group or smart device at a moment’s notice by pressing the Action button on the connecting device.

Want more punch? Add more power.
The Bose Smart Soundbar delivers full immersion all on its own. But you can still add to the experience to make up for any limitations in your space or for a more cinema-like experience. Dial up low-end fullness with a wireless bass module or take spaciousness to another level with surround speakers. Or add both to round off a full home cinema system.*
*Bass Module and surround speakers sold separately.

Bose SimpleSync
Pairing your Bose Smart Soundbar to compatible Bose products is now easier than ever with updated SimpleSync technology. Away from your phone? No app, no problem. Press and hold the Bluetooth® button on each device to group and sync their sound for audio that follows you from room to room. You can now also connect your Bose Smart Soundbar to a pre-existing group or smart device at a moment’s notice by pressing the Action button on the connecting device.

An app is all it takes.
From guided set-up to choosing all your preferences, the Bose app is the key to accessing everything Smart Soundbar has to offer. Connect the soundbar to your TV using either HDMI™ eARC/ARC or the optical audio connection (both cables are included) and power it up. The Bose app walks you through the rest. You can then set up voice control and Voice4Video, manage Bose Wi-Fi-enabled products, update software and browse all your music in one place.

Small, sleek soundbar.
This elegant and compact soundbar measures 69.5 cm wide (27.5") by 6 cm (2.25") tall and fits perfectly under any TV. Or choose the optional bracket to mount it on your wall (sold separately). The top surface is a sleek matte black and is complemented by a perforated wraparound metal grille – all designed to look great in your home.

What's in the box?

Bose Smart Soundbar
HDMI™ cable
Optical cable
Power cord
Remote control (battery included)
Quick start guide

Step into a new realm of realism. Unlike other TVs, Sony's expanded colour volume keeps images vivid and saturated even at high luminance levels, so you see pictures just as the creators intended.

As bright as nature, dazzling and vibrant worlds
Imagine a brilliantly sunlit, snow-covered mountain landscape. With higher luminance than ever, this supremely bright TV can faithfully reproduce natural scenes in absolute detail, even in the brightest daylight.

Definitive contrast. Professional monitor core technology.

Crystal clear pictures. Refined and real.
Rediscover detail. XR Clear Image uses a custom database to intelligently convert your favourites to near 4K. Noise is minimised by XR Clear Image through zone division and dynamic frame analysis.2

Even fast-moving action stays smooth, bright and clear
Forget about blur. XR Motion Clarity™ analyses movement across several frames and precisely synchronises the backlight with on-screen motion so you see clear, bright images, however fast the action.

Unmatched realism with XR Processor™

Beautiful colours. Any angle. Any environment.

Sony's most cinematic sound. World’s first TV with Beam Tweeter.

Theatre-like surround, pictures and sound in harmony

title: Sony BRAVIA HTA9000 Theatre Bar 9 Soundbar
body_html:
Key Features

Taking sound above and beyond
Sony's top-of-the-range soundbar features 360 Spatial Sound Mapping with 13 speaker units, a new generation of surround technology for immersive, cinematic.

Rewriting the rules of surround sound
Go beyond conventional surround sound. Combining physical and phantom speakers, BRAVIA Theatre Bar 9 creates a wider surround sound field for outstanding immersion.

Makes everywhere the best seat
It doesn’t matter which seat you’re in. It doesn’t even matter what your room’s acoustics are like. Sound Field Optimization lets everyone experience movie theatre surround sound.

Calibrated to suit your room
No need to remodel your home to get movie theatre acoustics. Sound Field Optimization analyses your room's acoustic characteristics, then uses advanced signal processing to overwrite them with those of a movie theatre.

Innovative acoustic design with 13 speaker units
There’s more to great surround sound than signal processing alone. Your physical speakers need to deliver exceptional acoustic performance too – and BRAVIA Theatre Bar 9 doesn’t disappoint.

New 2-way speaker
Discover clear, wide surround sound from a single soundbar. The Bar 9 features a new 2-way speaker with added tweeters for front and centre, delivering wider surround sound and a precise sound image.

Quad woofer and passive radiators deliver deep bass
Don’t be fooled by the slimline design. Thanks to built-in quad woofers and passive radiators, the Bar 9 generates the type of deep, resonant bass you’d expect from much larger speakers.

Hear sound from overhead
Up-firing speakers reflect sound off the ceiling for immersive overhead audio. 360 Spatial Sound Mapping creates phantom ceiling speakers for even more atmospheric sound.

So easy to use
BRAVIA Theatre Bar 9 makes surround sound simple. From initial set-up to smartphone control, it's all about minimum effort, maximum enjoyment.

Crystal clear voice. Precise dialogue.
No more muffled voices. Combined with compatible BRAVIA TVs, Sony's new Voice Zoom 3™ powered by AI machine learning recognises human voices and amplifies or reduces their volume so even faint dialogue sounds loud and clear.2, 4

Do it all with BRAVIA Connect1
The BRAVIA Connect smartphone app guides you through initial settings, assists with troubleshooting, and lets you control volume, sound field and more. It also notifies you about software updates and lets you control a compatible TV too.2,3

Set up in seconds
Simply plug in the Bar 9, connect to your TV using HDMI, and power on. With LAN, HDMI IN and HDMI OUT (eARC), you’re all set to enjoy a new spatial surround sound experience.

Movies feel so real
With its HDMI 2.1 capability, BRAVIA Theatre Bar 9 ensures the original picture quality of any source is preserved, right up to 8K HDR.

An immersive gaming experience
Lose yourself in gaming. Enjoy immersive overhead sound with the PlayStation®5 console, optimised picture settings by Auto HDR Tone Mapping and Auto Genre Picture Mode when connecting compatible BRAVIA™ TVs and PS5® console. This product also supports VRR, ALLM and SBTM for more realistic gaming.5

Stream music from your favourite services
It's not all about movies. You can also enjoy music in high-quality upmixed sound. Built-in support for Spotify Connect™ and Apple AirPlay lets you play all your favourite tracks.

Bluetooth® connection6
Stream audio content wirelessly. Bluetooth® technology makes it easy to enjoy music, podcasts and more from your smartphone, tablet or laptop.

Boost your entertainment with mighty bass

Key Features

NQ8 AI Gen3 Processor1
Samsung's most advanced AI-powered 8K processor creates our best overall 8K experience. Our NQ8 AI Gen3 Processor leverages 768 AI neural networks to optimise both picture and sound to deliver an 8K experience whether you are watching streaming services, playing your favourite video games or watching live sports.

Keep your TV clutter free3
Plug in all your HDMI sources into your Wireless One Connect box, which can be placed in any direction within a distance of 10 meters from the TV, wirelessly transmitting up to an 8K 120Hz signal to keep your TV clutter free.

Enjoy the action with minimal distraction
The anti-glare technology reduces glare from external light sources, such as indoor and outdoor lighting. Now you can enjoy your favourite entertainment without closing the blinds.4

AI Mode
AI Mode offers a quick access menu to adjust adaptive picture and sound settings, intelligently optimising your TV experience to the surroundings and the content you're watching.

Adaptive Sound Pro
Experience sound just as the creators intended, with clear voices and vivid, balanced tones. Your TV's AI processor recognises different sounds and optimises them based on characteristics of both the room and audio content, before ultimately refining them with audio remastering technology.5

Quantum Matrix Technology Pro
Quantum Matrix Technology Pro is our most innovative 8K backlighting technology.6 Setting the standard in Samsung picture quality, our proprietary Quantum Mini LEDs deliver incredible blacks, brilliant contrast and greater detail expression in both the darkest and brightest scenes.

Colour Booster Pro
Colour Booster Pro transforms the way you experience TV by leveraging AI to intelligently enhance colour expression, making each scene more vivid and dynamic.7

AI Motion Enhancer Pro
Our NQ8 AI Gen3 processor leverages AI to sharpen and smooth out the motion of text. This takes watching live sports to another level.8

Auto HDR Remastering Pro
Automatically upscale your standard dynamic range (SDR) content into high dynamic range (HDR-like) quality by using AI algorithms scene-by-scene to deliver brighter highlights, more vibrant colours and clearer details.9

Motion Xcelerator 4K 240Hz
Level up your gaming experience with exceptional motion enhancements up to 4K 240Hz VRR. Providing crisp visuals at high speeds, unlock peak performance in every round.10 HDMI 2.1 compatibility provides access to ultra-high bandwidth for compatible devices, helping you keep ahead of the competition.10

Gaming Hub

AI Auto Game Mode

Dolby Atmos®

Your Samsung TV includes a 90W 6.2.4 channel sound system featuring built-in up, down, side and centre-firing speakers with True Dolby Atmos support to deliver a larger-than-life cinematic experience.14

Active Voice Amplifier Pro
Enjoy clear dialogue, no matter what's going on. Our AI technology helps enhance voice clarity by analysing ambient noise and background sounds from your content.15

AI Energy Mode
Easily monitor your power consumption by activating AI Energy Mode. This feature automatically detects and analyses surrounding light levels and usage behaviours to adjust the brightness if required.16

What you want to watch all in one place

title: Samsung 85" The Frame Pro NEO QLED 4K Mini LED Smart AI TV [2025]
body_html:
Key Features

Modern Frame Design with Wireless One Connect
With a sleek, minimalist design, The Frame Pro is a masterpiece in itself. It also connects wirelessly to other devices, so you can adjust your setup and rearrange your room to your liking.1

Transforms your TV into an Art Gallery
Transform The Frame Pro into art when you're not watching TV. Find the right piece to display from the Samsung Art Store’s wide selection of artwork from renowned galleries.2

Stunning visuals for art and entertainment alike
Immerse yourself in superb Neo QLED picture quality when watching TV. Quantum Mini LEDs combined with Quantum Dot technology bring every image to life on your screen with brilliant colour, incredible depth and precise contrast.

Samsung Vision AI meets The Frame Pro
Enjoy new features with Samsung's Vision AI, now in The Frame. This next-level intelligence allows your TV to better recognise and adjust to your needs, delivering a variety of new opportunities for entertainment.

World-famous galleries in your living room
Curate your personal art gallery and display it at home. With over 3,000 options from world-famous artists and institutions in the Art Store, you can easily find the right pieces to show off your style. Plus, you’ll get the first 2 months free if you sign up for a monthly subscription.3

Brightness Sensor
The Brightness Sensor detects ambient light and auto-adjusts the screen's brightness and colour tone to retain the artwork's original look. It even adapts to changing light conditions, so you can enjoy the same pristine look regardless of the lighting in your room.4

Motion Sensor
With a motion sensor, The Frame Pro detects when you’ve entered the room and automatically turns on to display your artwork. When it detects that you've left the room, it'll switch off to help save energy.5

Enjoy your art with less distractions
Display your artwork to a gallery standard. The Anti Glare Matte Display spectacularly scatters light to help create a premium matte finish that looks almost as good as a real canvas whilst reducing distractions when you're watching TV.6

Enjoy ArtfulColour validated by PANTONE
Meet fully authentic colour representation, validated by PANTONE. The Frame Pro reproduces the rich and diverse colours you would expect to see in gallery lighting, made to look realistic with the matte texture of the canvas.7

Samsung's most advanced AI powered 4K processor8
Powered by 128 AI neural networks, this AI processor enhances your picture and sound to superb heights. Enjoy the best 4K TV experience, whether you're watching streaming services, playing your favourite video games, or watching live sports.8

Sharpens and smooths the motion of objects and text with NQ4 AI Gen3 Processor
AI Gen3 processor leverages AI to sharpen and smooth out the motion of objects and text. This takes watching live sports and action movies to another level.9

Catch every word with minimal distractions
Enjoy clear dialogue, no matter what's going on. AI technology enhances voice clarity by analysing ambient noise and background sounds from your content.10

1 TV requires a separate power cable connection. Operating distance can vary depending on the surrounding environment. Wireless One Connect may not work well if there is an obstruction, such as a wall, hindering its connection to the TV within your home. Wireless One Connect box may not work properly if placed inside a closed metal cabinet.
2 Stream complimentary curated art or additional artworks available via subscription. Internet connection required. Offering 30 refreshed artworks monthly through Art Store Streams and over 70 ambient content supported complimentary throughout the year.
3 The ‘2 months free’ offer applies only when signing up for a paid monthly subscription.
4 Brightness sensor performance may vary depending on the ambient brightness level. Brightness sensor may not operate well in an environment over 1000 lux.
5 Motion sensor gets activated after turning it on the setting and only operates in Art Mode. Motion sensor performance may vary depending on the light condition.
6 The LS03F has been independently verified as Glare Free: Reflection Glare UGR <10, Discomfort Glare UGR <22, Disability Glare UGR <34 by UL LLC. (UL Solutions), Certificate Number: V166045 – Exp. 31/12/2025.
7 Validation for TV colour accuracy that expresses the same colour under standard light source (D65 based) with paper texture. (Error within ΔE ≤ 3.0 level that a person cannot feel colour difference). Picture quality may vary depending on quality and resolution of source content and viewing conditions. Screen image simulated for illustrative purposes. "
8 Compared to NQ4 AI Gen2 Processor. Picture quality of upscaled content will vary depending on the quality and resolution of source content and may not apply to PC connection and Game Mode.
9 Viewing experience may vary according to types of content and format. Upscaling may not apply to PC connection and Game Mode.
10 Performance may vary depending on installation environment and surroundings.

Crisp and bright, enhanced Full Array LED
Lose yourself in pictures full of amazing contrast and real-life depth. A newly designed local dimming structure powered by Cognitive Processor XR™ brings scenes vividly to life.

What you want to watch all in one place

Just use your voice to control your TV with help from Google

body_html:
Clear, crisp speech
Hear amazing voice clarity from the Centre Up-firing Channel, and audio that locks to the on-screen action.

Enter a world of virtual 3D sound
Put yourself at the centre of immersive, realistic sound. Triple Level Spatial Sound creates an extra layer of virtual audio*, that helps you feel like you're in a dome of sound.
*Triple Level Spatial Sound’ is available in CINEMA / AI Sound Pro Mode. The mid-layer is created using Sound Bar’s speaker channel. The sound of the front and front-top speakers are synthesised to build a sound field. If there is no rear speaker, the rear field cannot be created.

3.1.1-channel sound
Become part of the scene with room-filling 400W 3.1.1-channel sound and the immersive excellence of Dolby Atmos® and DTS:X®.*
*Dolby Atmos® and DTS:X® enabled TV / Player and compatible source content required. Dolby and Dolby Vision are registered trademarks of Dolby Laboratories Licensing Corporation. The double-D symbol is a trademark of Dolby Laboratories Licensing Corporation.

Upgrade your sound
Experience richer sound. LG Smart Up-Mixer converts 2-channel audio into stunning virtual multi-channel sound.*
*Feature not available on Music Mode.

Sound engineered for what you enjoy
Enjoy great sound, whether you’re watching movies, catching up on the news, or listening to music. With AI Sound Pro, LG Sound Bar's intelligent algorithm analyses your content to help deliver enhanced performance.

Sound and vision in perfect harmony
A winning combination. WOW Orchestra uses your LG Sound Bar and compatible LG TV speakers^ at the same time to create impactful sound. Hear crisp, clear dialogue that appears to come directly from the characters on screen, and an expanded soundstage for audio with extreme width and depth.
^For the full list of compatible TV and sound bar models, visit lg.com/au/wow-orchestra-interface

Sound in sync for dynamic gaming
Free up ports on your TV and connect 4K gaming consoles to your LG Sound Bar, without compromising graphics performance. With VRR and ALLM, your Sound Bar helps ensure smooth, low input lag gaming.*
*Sound Bar, console and compatible TV to be connected via HDMI. VRR and ALLM support required for console and TV. HDMI pass-through supports up to 4K @ 120Hz YCbCR 4:2:0 at 8-bits.

Key Features

400W Total Power & 3.1.1 Channels

Centre up-firing speaker for clear dialogue

Dolby Atmos® for above and around sound

WOW Orchestra uses LG Sound Bar & compatible LG TV speakers together^ for more impactful sound

120Hz 4K Pass-through & VRR/ALLM for Dynamic Gaming Sound

Infinity Air Design
With an edge-to-edge display, you can be captivated by a full picture, with virtually no bezel. The slim profile and Infinity Air stand make the TV look like it is floating in the air.*

Quantum Matrix Technology Pro is our innovative 8K backlighting technology. Setting the standard in Samsung picture quality, our proprietary Quantum Mini LEDs deliver incredible blacks, brilliant contrast and greater detail expression in both the darkest and brightest scenes.

True Dolby Atmos with 6.2.4ch Sound
Immerse yourself in the action with the breathtaking realism of multi-directional sound, right in your home. Your Samsung TV includes a 90W 6.2.4 channel sound system featuring built-in up, down, side and centre-firing speakers with True Dolby Atmos support to deliver a larger-than-life cinematic experience.*

Motion Rate 200 with AI Enhancer
See fast-moving scenes with minimal blur and judder. AI further helps sharpen and smooth out the motion of objects and text, taking live sports and action movies to another level.*

QLED powered by Quantum Dot

* Compared to previous Samsung Smart TV.
** Available on HDR content only. Colour volume testing is capable of producing results greater than 100%. Q-series models produce more than 100% colour volume when tested using the IDMS 1.03b standard and DCI-P3 colour space. Brightness tested at maximum luminance with 10% White Window in HDR. Testing verified by an independent third party.

Adaptive Picture

Object Tracking Sound Pro (OTS Pro)
Take your sound to a whole new level of immersion, thanks to twelve built-in speakers that tracks words and motion on screen. From rolling thunder and lighting over the Savanah to the roaring crowds at the footy – it’s so realistic, you’ll feel as if you’re actually there.

Tizen Smart Hub
Explore endless entertainment with your favourite apps in one place. With automated content curation you can spend less time searching and more time streaming the movies, games and shows you love.*

body_html:
Harmonic Presence. Slim and chic for your living space.
Takes centre stage in any room. The slim and thin TV design graces your living space with shapes, materials, colours and surface treatments that blend beautifully with interior décor, walls and home theatre products.

Pure black OLED, bright and beautiful
Brilliant pictures. We’ve taken the infinite blacks and stunning detail of OLED for astonishing texture and realism.

Over 8 million self-lit pixels, intense brightness and contrast
The pinnacle of precision. Our OLED screen individually and expertly controls 8 million self-illuminating pixels, turning each one on or off to dark and light for deeper blacks and more dazzling colours.

Clear pictures. Refined and upscaled to 4K.
Your favourite films, enhanced and enriched with extra detail. XR Clear Image uses a custom database of textures to intelligently convert any content to near 4K quality, whatever the source.1

Even fast-moving action stays clear and blur-free
All the action, free of blur and judder. XR OLED Motion detects and analyses visual elements on successive frames, then creates and inserts extra frames between the originals for smoother scenes.

Unmatched realism with XR Processor™
Powered for precision. Our XR Processor™ features a scene recognition system that detects and analyses data with flawless accuracy, then optimises the picture for ultimate realism.

Screen speaker, always cinematic
Bring cinema home. Actuators behind the screen vibrate and turn it into a speaker that delivers clear and immersive sound from the centre with the same sound structure as the cinema. The newly equipped tweeter brings out the surround feel to provide a cinema-like experience.

Sound from the screen, precisely matching action
Sound and pictures, perfectly in sync. Acoustic Surface Audio +™ with tweeter turns every part of the screen into a powerful speaker that emits sound from exactly the right place in the scene. Hear dialogue straight from the actor and bring the theatre-like experience to your home.

Auto HDR Tone Mapping
Auto HDR Tone Mapping instantly optimises HDR settings during your PS5® initial setup. Even in dark shadow and bright highlights, you’ll see fine details and true colours.2,3

Auto Genre Picture Mode
BRAVIA automatically switches into Game Mode with PS5® to minimise lag and maximise responsiveness. It switches back to Standard Mode when watching movies for more expressive scenes.4

Dolby Vision® for gaming. Supported.
This is how your game world should be. Incredibly vibrant colours, lifelike contrast in light and dark, intense brightness. With Dolby Vision®, gaming reaches a whole new level of depth and realism.

Various features in HDMI 2.1
With 4K/120fps, a Variable Refresh Rate (VRR) and Auto Low Latency Mode (ALLM), our TVs give you smooth and clear movement for responsive gameplay.5,6,7

77" 4K Ultra HD OLED producing pure blacks & lifelike brightness

200 motion rate and variable refresh rate via HDMI

Experience the way movies were intended with Dolby Vision, Atmos and IMAX Enhanced

XR Processor enhances and details for a lifelike picture quality

Modern Frame Design with Wireless One Connect
With a sleek, minimalist design, The Frame Pro is a masterpiece in itself. It also connects wirelessly to other devices, so you can adjust your setup and rearrange your room to your liking.1

Transforms your TV into an Art Gallery
Transform The Frame Pro into art when you're not watching TV. Find the right piece to display from the Samsung Art Store’s wide selection of artwork from renowned galleries.2

Immerse yourself in superb Neo QLED picture quality when watching TV. Quantum Mini LEDs combined with Quantum Dot technology bring every image to life on your screen with brilliant colour, incredible depth and precise contrast.

Enjoy new features with Samsung's Vision AI, now in The Frame. This next-level intelligence allows your TV to better recognise and adjust to your needs, delivering a variety of new opportunities for entertainment.

World-famous galleries in your living room

Brightness Sensor
The Brightness Sensor detects ambient light and auto-adjusts the screen's brightness and colour tone to retain the artwork's original look. It even adapts to changing light conditions, so you can enjoy the same pristine look regardless of the lighting in your room.4

Motion Sensor

Enjoy your art with less distractions

Meet fully authentic colour representation, validated by PANTONE. The Frame Pro reproduces the rich and diverse colours you would expect to see in gallery lighting, made to look realistic with the matte texture of the canvas.7

Samsung's most advanced AI powered 4K processor8

Sharpens and smooths the motion of objects and text with NQ4 AI Gen3 Processor

Key Features

Feel virtually every shade of colour as intended in powerful 4K
Feel virtually every shade of colour as intended. Powerful 4K upscaling ensures you get up to 4K resolution for the content you love.1

An elegant metal design that upgrades your space
Inspired by aircraft design, the Metal Stream Design features a luxurious metal body. With no additional bezel required, a single sheet of metal is used to create a slim bezel, enabling a truly immersive experience.

Enhanced contrast with rich darkness and brilliant light
High Dynamic Range helps increase the ratio between the lightest and darkest areas on screen. This brings out a wide spectrum of colours and brilliant contrast for all the visual details.

Watch your favourite content in up to 4K
Powerful 4K upscaling ensures you get up to 4K resolution to help it look its best.2

Fine-tuned colours for a vibrant, lifelike picture
Experience rich images that come to life with a huge range of colours. From vivid documentaries to vibrant animated worlds, your viewing experience will be anything but dull.

Easily discover and access your games from one screen
Save time and speed up the game selection process.3 Stream over 100 blockbuster games with Xbox Game Pass or access other cloud gaming services – no downloads and console required.4 Plus, find your console gaming and standalone apps like YouTube, Spotify, Twitch & Discord all in one place.3

Experience picture clarity with smooth motions
Experience clear picture as Motion Xcelerator automatically estimates the motion information between frames and then uses it to predict the subsequent frames in a manner that improves the smoothness of motion.5

Connect and manage your smart home devices, all from your TV
Control your compatible Samsung and third-party devices through your Samsung smart TV. Monitor your electricity usage, control your lighting, be notified when your washing is finished, or view your home cameras from your couch. Designed to make your life easier, more secure, and more connected.6

Virtual sound that tracks the action
Create a surround sound experience with virtual top-channel audio that follows the action so that you can be immersed in the audio.7

Sound that adjusts to your surroundings & content
Adaptive Sound ensures you rarely miss a word by adjusting the volume of dialogue based on real time scene analysis by content type.8

Monitor energy consumption
Easily monitor your power consumption by activating AI Energy Mode. This feature automatically detects and analyses surrounding light levels and usage behaviours to adjust the brightness if required.9

Wireless music streaming
Your favorite tracks are at your fingertips. Easily stream your favorite music directly from your smart device to your sound bar via Bluetooth.

Easy setup and use

Denon Dialogue Enhancer improves dialogue intelligibility with three different modes—ideal for movies and TV shows. You can even turn up the dialogue without having to adjust overall volume.

High-performance build quality
The DHT-S517 is equipped with a left and right midrange and tweeter, a dedicated center channel, plus two up-firing speakers. Together with the wireless subwoofer, this adds up to a powerful 3.1.2 speaker configuration.

Sound modes for any occasion

Denon Pure mode

body_html:
Overview

Transform how you experience movies, TV shows, and video games. This Ultra HD High Speed HDMI cable supports the highest resolutions, refresh rates, and most immersive viewing experience available, including compatibility with Dolby Vision™. This advanced high dynamic range technology offers unmatched brightness, contrast and color. To experience it fully you’ll need every link in your viewing chain to be Dolby Vision compatible, from streaming devices such as Apple TV 4K to UHDTV or A/V receiver and your HDMI cable that brings them together. This Ultra HD High Speed cable is up to the task and compatible with any HDMI device, just plug in and enjoy the next generation of high definition home entertainment.

See more with dolby vision
An amazing new television and movie experience from the comfort of your living room. Many of your favorite movies and TV shows are already available in Dolby Vision with media streaming companies like iTunes, Netflix and Amazon creating new shows in Dolby Vision. Dolby Vision leverages HDR (High Dynamic Range) and wide color gamut imaging technology to deliver all new levels of depth and realism. Dolby Vision makes a difference on any resolution or screen size because it improves each pixel. With screen brightness and illumination, a sharper contrast between darks and lights, and billions of colors, it brings the images on your screen to life like never before.

Future ready
The Ultra HD High Speed HDMI cable from Belkin is prepared for Dolby Vision, and more. Future-proof your home entertainment with a cable that’s ready for the next generation of audio and video.

Reliable connection
The enhanced, lifelike content of Dolby Vision needs an ultra-reliable connection to stream smoothly between streaming devices and your TV or display. Belkin’s Ultra HD High Speed HDMI cable is up to the task, delivering a faster refresh and eliminating motion blur, for the best possible viewing experience.

Ideal length
Designed to fit seamlessly into your home environment, this minimal, 2-metre cable is the perfect length to connect your laptop or streaming device to your UHDTV set up.

Key Features

Dolby Vision compatible

Supports 8K HDR (Dolby Vision and HDR 10)

2-metre cable is perfect for connecting to UHDTVs

Compatible with any HDMI device

title: LG 48" OLED EVO C5 AI 4K UHD Smart TV [2025]
body_html:
The key to powerful, fast, beautiful TV
See intense detail and definition on the screen. Engineered to analyse and upscale each frame, and with the intelligence to recognise faces, our alpha 9 AI Processor 4K Gen 8 processor produces not only stunning 4K visuals, but enhanced facial expression and depth.*
*Image quality dependent on source material.

Bring scenes to life, brilliantly
Make each scene a masterpiece. AI Super Upscaling and OLED Dynamic Tone Mapping work together to analyse each frame and enhance resolution, brightness, depth, and clarity.*
*Image quality dependent on source material. AI Picture Pro may not work with copyright-protected content services.

Revealing detail in the darkness
Unveil mesmerising depth, detail and contrast. With no backlight to dull their brilliance, LG OLED's self-lit pixels allow black levels to maintain their rich appearance, for stunning images in almost any lighting conditions.

See the full picture, with full-on colour
Enjoy vibrant, accurate colours with verified 100% Colour Volume* for enhanced colour reproduction.
*Colour volume testing is capable of producing results greater than 100%. 100% Colour Volume independently tested in accordance with Intertek Test Specification to the DCI-P3 colour space with D65 white point.

Sync your TV to your voice
Get personalised recommendations, just by asking. AI Voice ID recognises the unique signature of each voice to curate tailored viewing for everyone at home. Just press the remote's AI Button to get started.*
*Depending on language, voice clarity and available content or source material, voice commands may not always deliver or respond to the requested command.

See it, just the way you like it
Customise your viewing experience, the easy way. Choose your favourite images from the TV's selection and AI Picture Wizard will analyse your preferences to create your ideal sharpness, contrast, and colour settings.

Hear it, just the way you love it
Enjoy sound, tailored just for you. Choose the audio you like from a selection of sound clips on your TV and let AI Sound Wizard create a customised profile tuned to your preferences.

Voices cut through bustling backdrops
Even in loud action scenes, you can hear the characters talk over the noise. AI Voice Remastering enhances the clarity of dialogue without effecting the rest of the audio mix.*
*Must be activated through the Sound Mode menu.

Sleek and minimalist simplicity
A modern design with narrow bezels brings discreet style to your space and helps keep you fully immersed in the brilliance on screen.

Set your sights on victory
Get your game on, with minimal lag and motion blur. A blazingly fast 0.1ms response time, 144Hz VRR, NVIDIA G-Sync and AMD FreeSync Premium come together to create clear, smooth pictures.*
*Ultra High Speed cable, compatible content and Game console or PC Graphics card required for HFR gaming at 40Hz-144hz. 144Hz Mode is compatible with PC-connected content. G-Sync features require a compatible GPU.

Breathtaking home cinema
Experience cinema as the director intended. By optimising images to surrounding light levels and disabling motion smoothing and sharpness settings, FILMMAKER MODE™ Ambient Light helps preserve the director's vision. Combined with ultra-vivid images from Dolby Vision*, movies can appear true to their original form.
*Dolby Vision High Dynamic Range content required. FILMMAKER MODE™ Ambient Light is a trademark of UHD Alliance, Inc.

Be swept away by sound
Feel like you're in the centre of all the action, with lifelike surround sound that moves all around you.*
*Dolby Atmos source content required for full audio effect.

Key Features

Optimised AI picture and sound powered by the alpha 9 AI Processor 4K Gen 8

Incredibly realistic visuals with Perfect Black & Accurate Colour.

An immersive cinema experience with Dolby Vision & Dolby Atmos1

webOS smart features, including AI Search, AI Picture Wizard, Google Cast & Apple AirPlay 22

Ultra Slim Design with incredibly narrow bezels

Advanced gameplay with NVIDIA G-Sync, AMD FreeSync Premium®, XBOX & NVIDIA GeForce Now cloud gaming

webOS smart features, including AI Search, AI Picture Wizard, Google Cast & Apple AirPlay 22

title: Monster 1 Socket Surge Protector with USB-C/A (White)
body_html:
Introducing the all-new Monster Single Outlet Surge Protector with 2 x USB A & 2 x USB C Fast Charging Ports! This powerful surge protector is designed to provide ultimate protection for your mobile devices, while also giving you the convenience of fast charging. With its LED surge indicator light and fireproof technology, you can rest easy knowing that your devices are protected against power surges and spikes. Plus, the surge protector has a $10,000 connected equipment warranty, so you can have peace of mind knowing that your devices are covered in case of any unforeseen accidents. The two USB A and two USB C fast charging ports are perfect for charging your mobile devices quickly and efficiently. Whether you're at home, in the office, or on the go, this surge protector has got you covered. So why wait? Protect your devices and enjoy fast charging with the Monster Single Outlet Surge Protector with 2 x USB A & 2 x USB C Fast Charging Ports today!

Why do I need a Surge Protector
A surge protector is an electrical device designed to protect your electronic devices from power surges or voltage spikes. Power surges can occur due to lightning strikes, power outages, or fluctuations in the electrical grid. Without a surge protector, these power surges can cause damage to your electronic devices, including your computer, TV, and other appliances. A surge protector helps to absorb and redirect the excess voltage away from your devices, protecting them from damage. Additionally, surge protectors can also prevent electrical fires and increase the lifespan of your electronic devices. In summary, using a surge protector can help protect your electronic devices from power surges and increase their lifespan, ultimately saving you money in the long run.

Key Features

Powerful surge protector is designed to provide ultimate protection for your mobile devices

USB A and two USB C fast charging ports

LED surge indicator light and fireproof technology

$10,000 connected equipment warranty

Specifications:

175J total
Dual USB & USB-C fast charging ports
Surge protection indicator lets you know when your devices are surge protected
For use with appliance and home office equipment
3 year manufacturer’s warranty
Fireproof technology
$10,000 (AUD) connected equipment cover

body_html:
Crisp and bright, enhanced Full Array LED
Lose yourself in pictures full of amazing contrast and real-life depth. A newly designed local dimming structure powered by Cognitive Processor XR™ brings scenes vividly to life.

Contrast intensified. Depth amplified.
XR Contrast Booster precisely balances light across the screen, adjusting brightness for higher peaks in glare and deeper blacks in shadow. Peak brightness is higher than ever for sublime depth and detail.

Everything upscaled close to 4K quality
Whatever the content or source, images are upscaled close to 4K. XR 4K Upscaling accesses a vast database to intelligently recreate lost texture and detail.1

Intelligent motion processing for fast-moving, blur-free scenes
By analysing motion across several frames, Cognitive Processor XR™ with XR Motion Clarity™ ensures fast-moving sports and action-packed movies stay smooth, bright and clear.

Synchronised. Sound and picture harmony.
Hear sound straight from the screen, perfectly matching the action. Cognitive Processor XR™ turns any sound immersive with more precise sound position.

What you hear matches what you see
With Acoustic Multi-Audio™, it feels as though sound is coming from the right place in the scene, precisely matching visuals. Far more immersive than conventional TVs where sound comes from beneath the screen.

Auto Genre Picture Mode
BRAVIA XR™ automatically switches into Game Mode with PS5™ to minimise lag and maximise responsiveness. It switches back to Standard Mode when watching movies for more expressive scenes.2

What you want to watch all in one place
Browse 700,000+ movies and TV episodes from across your streaming services, all in one place and organised into topics and genres based on what interests you.3,4,5

Just use your voice to control your TV with help from Google
Your TV is more helpful than ever. Ask Google to find movies, stream apps, play music, and control the TV - all with your voice. Even get answers, control smart home devices, and more. Just say “Ok Google” to get started.6, 7, 8

Kids Profile
With Kids Profile, you call the shots. This special feature helps you guide children to age-appropriate content, in a space that’s all their own. Set kid-friendly filters for apps, movies and shows. Limit how long they can watch and easily set bedtimes.

Smart TV powered by Google TV with hands free voice control and your favourite streaming apps in one place
